Hi friend, Yesterday on _Meet the Press_ , [Donald Trump erupted with a fountain of lies and falsehoods about American elections](youtube.com/watch?si=KM2vSkExyTw6aUqs&t=2217&v=zYmQctYXIeM&feature=youtu.be) before abruptly walking off. Trump accused the California primary of being "rigged" and claimed "they are cheating." When interviewer Kristen Welker asked him to provide evidence for these outrageous claims, his response was simply: "All I need to do is look." Donald Trump's claims that elections are crooked, stolen, and rigged are just that: **claims without evidence.** Secretaries of state across the country, both Republican and Democrat, run clean, fair, and verifiable elections. Trump's baseless lies and false accusations sow mistrust among the American public, undermine our democracy, and have contributed to threats and violence against election officials. But Trump's administration goes beyond rhetoric. Conspiracy theorists and election deniers across the country are pushing policies that disenfranchise American citizens. This president is attacking the foundation of our democracy by encouraging gerrymandering, restricting vote-by-mail, and promoting illegal voter purge efforts designed to disenfranchise eligible Americans. **VRF stands up to these attacks by helping pass legislation to protect your right to vote and by supporting leaders who are willing to defend our democracy when it comes under attack.** But if Donald Trump and his allies are already laying the groundwork to undermine confidence in our elections again, we cannot afford to wait until the damage is done. **[That's why we're asking you The Supreme Court ruled in favor of voter suppression and against underrepresented communities in Louisiana v. Callais , folks.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems]
On Friday morning over 600 hundred Louisianans showed up to the Louisiana state capitol to protest and speak out against a new Congressional map proposed by the Louisiana GOP that will erase Louisiana's two black majority districts and establish all white districts.
During the hearing on redistricting, GOP State Senator Jay Morris yelled "Shut up, boy" to my Executive Director Dadrius Lanus, a Black man, who, in Sen. Morris’s words was “commenting and talking” too loudly for him to concentrate.
Sir, I am a 70 year old Black man and we know what it means to be called “Boy.”
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems]
Senator Morris says we misheard. That the audio proves it. That he said “you all need to shut up” to the Black constituents behind him outraged that their votes won't be counted.
Senator Morris, an elected member of our legislature, thinks if he had yelled “you all need to shut up” it would be better.
It wouldn't.
What Senator Morris doesn’t understand is that White people have been telling Black folk to “shut up" for over 250 years.
What Senator Morris doesn’t understand is that we remember being told we were 3/5ths of a person. That even when we won personhood in the eyes of the law, they instituted poll taxes and “reading” tests. That when we marched and dreamed and cried and buried loved ones who had hung as strange fruit from tall trees because they raised their voices too loud that what Black people have always wanted is equality.
Or maybe Senator Morris does understand all that.
I don’t know.
What I do know is that I am a 70 year old Black man. And I don’t let anyone call me or my brothers “Boy.”
Please, chip in $10 or more today split between the Louisiana Democrats and Resist Reclaim Rebuild. Let’s show them that they may have gutted the Voting Rights Act and canceled our election, but we will not be silenced. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
HELP THE LOUISIANA DEMS FIGHT BACK! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems]
Thank you for coming to Louisiana’s aid in our time of crisis.
Louisiana Democrats

clean_body: We need your help to defend democracy during this urgent moment | Peter, When Louisiana Governor Jeff Landry declared a state of emergency and suspended his state’s primary elections in order to redraw their congressional map, it meant that 45,000 ballots would be discarded. When the Virginia Supreme Court invalidated the results of a ballot initiative to approve the state’s new map, the ruling silenced 3 million Virginians. In Alabama, after the Supreme Court gave them permission to revisit their map, officials shut down an ongoing primary election and tried to ignore the ballots already cast by thousands of voters. It’s a disturbing trend. Republicans are willing to do the once unthinkable — throwing out already-cast ballots — in order to maintain their grip on power. And this is just the beginning. These anti-democracy attacks will only get worse if we don't mount a fierce opposition to stop this ominous trend in its tracks. election.

possible: Only a small fraction of
Pennsylvanians have
truly tuned in to this election — and you’re one of them. And truthfully,
we can’t win without folks like you chipping in early and laying the
foundation for victory.

subject: Judicial Watch: FBI Records Reveal Witness Account that SWAT Officer Recovered ‘Remote Device’ from Butler Shooter’s Pocket
body:
Judicial Watch announced today that it forced the release of 48 heavily redacted pages from the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) through a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit that indicate that a Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) officer at the July 2024 presidential rally for Donald Trump in Butler, Pennsylvania, recovered a “gray remote device” with an antenna from would-be assassin Thomas Crooks’ pocket after he was killed.*

subject: 18 Days Until Freedom Fest 🇺🇸
body:
Get your tickets now before it's too late!
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Peter,
In just **18 DAYS** , thousands of Coloradans will gather in Castle Rock for the inaugural RMV Freedom Fest — a two-day celebration of America's 250th Birthday, Colorado's 150th Birthday, and the values that make our country worth celebrating: Faith, Family, Freedom, and the Future.
Whether you're looking for world-class speakers, live music, championship rodeo action, family activities, great food, or an unforgettable patriotic weekend, Freedom Fest has something for everyone.
**🇺🇸 FEATURED SPEAKERS INCLUDE:**
• Greg Gutfeld
• Nick Shirley
• Lara Logan
• Dr. Kevin Roberts
• Mike Davis
• Chris Wright, U.S. Secretary of Energy
• Pastor Lorenzo Sewell
• Erin Lee
• Jeremy Dys
• Kelsey Reinhardt
• Patti Fox
• Seth Keshel
• Mark Cook
• Beverly Vance Aikins ...and more.
🎵 SPECIAL EVENTS:
• Back the Blue Bash featuring Dog the Bounty Hunter
• Curtis Grimes Concert
• Championship Rodeo
• Family Fun Festival
• Mountain Majesty Gala featuring Nick Shirley, Chris Wright, and Larry Gatlin
• Spectacular Drone Show Finale
🎟️ TICKET OPTIONS 🐎 Rodeo Admission — Starting at $45 🎤 Friday Day Pass — Starting at $95 🇺🇸 Saturday Day Pass — Starting at $125 ⭐ Full Weekend Pass — Starting at $195 👮 Back the Blue Bash — Starting at $95 🏔️ Mountain Majesty Gala — Starting at $195 👑 All-Access Weekend Pass — $475 (Best Value) 💎 VIP Weekend Pass — Premium Experience
This is more than an event. It's a chance to celebrate our country, connect with fellow Coloradans, and be part of something special as America turns 250.
Tickets are available now!
🎟 GET TICKETS: _**[RMVFreedomFest.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
June 26-27, 2025 Douglas County Fairgrounds Castle Rock, Colorado
The RMV Team
---
[FULL WEBSITE & TICKETS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**📣 BECOME A VOLUNTEER**
If you believe in what we're building, we'd love your help.
We're currently looking for volunteers to help make Freedom Fest a success. Volunteers who commit to a single 4-hour shift will receive _**complimentary day passes for both days of the festival**_ (evening events not included), allowing you to experience Freedom Fest while helping create something truly special for Colorado. There are a limited number of spots so grab yours before it's too late!
Whether you're greeting guests, assisting vendors, helping in VIP areas, or simply lending a hand where needed, you'll play a part in building what we believe will be the largest freedom-focused celebration Colorado has ever seen.
Interested in volunteering? Reply to this email and we'll connect you with our volunteer team.
[VOLUNTEER AT FREEDOM FEST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**🎤 FRIDAY MAIN STAGE
**
The opening day of Freedom Festival brings some of the most powerful voices in America to the main stage.
🔹 **Lara Logan** _— Award-winning Journalist_
**🔹** **Dr. Kevin Roberts —** _President of the Heritage Foundation_ 🔹 **Beverly Vance Aikin —** _Mother of VP JD Vance_
**🔹** **Mike Davis —** _Article III_
**🔹 Seth Keshel —** _Election Integrity Expert & Anaylst_ 🔹 **Jeremy Dys —** _First Liberty Institute_ 🔹 **Kelsey Reinhardt —** _President & CEO, CatholicVote_
🔹**Patti Fox** _— Public Safety Advocate_
🔹 **Erin Lee —** _Executive Director of Protect Kids Colorado_ 🔹 **Mark Cook —** _Election Integrity Founder_
🔹 **Pastor Christine Coleman, Heidi Ganahl, Jeff Hunt & more...**
Friday daytime also includes live music, hands-on workshops, and food trucks on-site all day. This is the **Aware · Act · Advocate** experience. You won't just listen — you'll leave with a plan.
[FRIDAY DAY PASS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**🚔 FRIDAY EVENING — BACK THE BLUE BASH**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Friday night is a patriotic celebration honoring the men and women who protect our communities.
**Featuring:**
• **DOG The Bounty Hunter** — _Keynote speaker_
• **Curtis Grimes Band** — _Breakout Texas country music artist_
•**District Attorney George Brauchler
** • **District Attorney Michael Allen**
• **Pastor Drake Hunter**
• **Jeff Hunt**
• Law enforcement leaders & special guests
**[General Admission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) — $95 | [VIP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) — $150**
[BACK THE BLUE BASH](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**🤠 SATURDAY — RODEO & FAMILY FUN FEST**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Saturday brings something for the whole family.
The rodeo kicks off with real Western action, followed by a Curtis Grimes concert and the Family Fun Fest — completely free for families.
**Family Fun Fest includes:**
• Bouncy Houses
• Petting Zoo
• Face Painting
• Magicians
• Sports Mascots
• Food Trucks & Live Music
**[Rodeo General Admission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) — $45 | [Rodeo VIP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) — $295** Not into the speakers? This is your perfect Saturday.
[RODEO & FAMILY FUN FEST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**🎙️ SATURDAY MAIN STAGE**
Saturday afternoon is headlined by one of the biggest names in media today.
🔹 **Greg Gutfeld —** _King of Late Night, host of GUTFELD!_
__🔹**Lee Habeeb —** _Creator/Host, Our American Stories_
🔹 **Dr. James Lindsay —** _Author & Researcher_
🔹 **Pastor Lorenzo Sewell —** _Delivered the benediction at 2025 Inauguration_
🔹 **Data Republican (Jennica Pounds) —** _AI & Government Waste Investigator_
🔹 **Jacki & Noelle Caskey —** _Pro-life mother & daughter from Jeffco_ __🔹**Colorado Republican Congressional Representatives**

Gutfeld is Saturday only. If that's the one name you came for, Saturday daytime is your ticket.
[SATURDAY DAY PASS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**🌟 SATURDAY EVENING — MOUNTAIN MAJESTY GALA + DRONE SHOW**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
The weekend ends with a night you won't forget.
The Mountain Majesty Gala is an elegant dinner event featuring some of the most compelling voices of the weekend — capped off with a spectacular drone show finale over Castle Rock.
**Featuring:**
******•** **Secretary of Energy Chris Wright**
**•** **Nick Shirley** — _Investigative journalist and immigration fraud whistleblower_
**•** **Larry Gatlin** — _Grammy-winning country and gospel legend_
**•** **Pastor Lorenzo Sewell**
**•** Special guest from Trump's cabinet!
**[General Admission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** — $195 | **[VIP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** — $995 | **[VIP + Photo Experience](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** — $1,995 (Or included with the [All-Access](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) & [VIP Weekend Pass](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.))
[MOUNTAIN MAJESTY GALA](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**Want to do it all?**
_**America only turns 250 once. Colorado only turns 150 once.**_

This is the weekend that marks both.
**[GET YOUR TICKET NOW →](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

name: Dan Cox
subject: 72 Hours Until Final Primary Financial Report
body:
We need your rush donation to save Maryland. | | | |
---
| | |
## 72 Hours To Raise Pre-Primary Report Funds.

Dear Dan Cox for Governor,

72 hours until our report cut off... Attacks by my establishment opponent are daily now because we are strong and running to win and have reached 10 million views. And with your rush donation we can reach the final 50,000 voters we need to contact.
[](https://us.list-manage.com/Vamjs7t6FCV?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
Today, a lifelong Democrat opponent in our GOP primary sent out a massive text blast and video falsely claiming that I am a "Democrat" and have colluded with democrats. Nothing could be further from the truth.

When I was five years old I began "campaigning" for Republican Ronald Reagan with my grandparents who offered me ice cream as we drove door to door canvassing in Baltimore County. I've been elected five times as a Registered Republican and have served as both Chairman and Secretary on two County GOP Central Committees in Maryland (my County and my wife's where we lived for a time). I was elected as one of the highest votes in the Eighth Congressional District of Maryland to nominate President Trump in 2020, and served on Lawyers for Trump in Philadelphia in 2020 where we fought in federal court to stop election fraud. I've worked for Republican congressman such as Roscoe Bartlett of Maryland's Sixth District, who just turned 100 years old this week, and I've been on the staff and volunteer teams of Republican presidential candidates including Ambassador Alan Keyes, President George W. Bush and President Donald J. Trump. I campaigned for Governor's Ehrlich and Hogan. I was elected as the highest Republican vote recipient in Frederick and Carroll County's Fourth District as State Delegate as a consistent, common sense conservative.

I am the only consistent Republican conservative in this race and I've never colluded with democrats in any political race \- like my opponent is alleged to have done when he is alleged to have met with Governor Moore early on in this race. **In fact, many do not know that Ed Hale made it his ambition to un-elect Governor Ehrlich and install Gov. O'Malley, who gave us 42 taxes including the Rain Tax, took our electric clean coal power plants off-line skyrocketing our electric bills, gave us the 2013 Gun Ban and the Transgender Equity Act, which opened the "equity" door to making our schools less safe and equal for girls and women in their sports, showers and hotel rooms when they travel on sports teams.**

When his attacks that I am "too conservative" failed because I am a common sense conservative talking about kitchen table expenses we are all facing, Ed Hale has now resorted to claiming that I am a "Democrat." Ludicrous and false.

I humbly ask for your vote and your urgently needed support tonight. With your help we will win this race.
Will you rush your donation tonight? [$100, or even $1000](https://us.list-manage.com/7jbTpYjdrcj?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)? Make securely here, and thank you.

[https://dancoxforgovernor.com/donate/](https://us.list-manage.com/1AUCGv7OVj8?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

Thank you! Together we will win and make Maryland Safe, Affordable and Prosperous again.

With genuine thanks,

Dan Cox, Candidate for Governor of Maryland
Lifelong Republican

Auth: Dan Cox for Governor;
Nick Krop, CPA, Treasurer.

Peter, you're not going to believe this.

According to a new Elon University poll 66% of Democrats say they feel conflicted, frustrated, disappointed, or just plain indifferent about being an American.

Meanwhile, 87% of Republicans say they feel proud or grateful to be an American (we still need to get that up to 100%).

ARE YOU PROUD TO BE AN AMERICAN?

YES [https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-tim-moore/060826_patriot_samoore/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=SA-Email&utm_campaign=06.08.26_Patriot_SAMoore&utm_content=Link&recurring=true] NO [https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-tim-moore/060826_patriot_samoore/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=SA-Email&utm_campaign=06.08.26_Patriot_SAMoore&utm_content=Link&recurring=true]

That's not just a statistic. That's a window into the soul of the modern left.

While Republicans are grateful for the greatest country on earth, Democrats can't even muster pride in the nation that gives them the freedom to complain about it.

North Carolina didn't send me to Washington to apologize for America. I go there to fight for it.

As we approach July 4th and America's 250th birthday, I want to know where YOU stand:

Are you proud to be an American? [https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-tim-moore/060826_patriot_samoore/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=SA-Email&utm_campaign=06.08.26_Patriot_SAMoore&utm_content=Link&recurring=true]

Let’s show unwavering support for this great nation.

Sincerely,

Congressman Tim Moore

North Carolina’s 14th District

Meanwhile, 87% of Republicans say they feel proud or grateful to be an American (we still need to get that up to 100%). ARE YOU PROUD TO BE AN AMERICAN? YES [] NO [] That's not just a statistic. That's a window into the soul of the modern left. While Republicans are grateful for the greatest country on earth, Democrats can't even muster pride in the nation that gives them the freedom to complain about it. North Carolina didn't send me to Washington to apologize for America. I go there to fight for it. As we approach July 4th and America's 250th birthday, I want to know where YOU stand: Are you proud to be an American? [] REPLY RIGHT NOW [] The left wants to tear down our history and replace our values. I'm fighting every single day to make sure they don't succeed. Let’s show unwavering support for this great nation. Sincerely, Congressman Tim Moore North Carolina’s 14th District This email was paid for by Friends of Tim Moore PO BOX 97275 RALEIGH, NC 27624

Peter,
Right now, rumors are swirling in the nation's capital.
In smoky backrooms across the city, conservative political operatives are whispering among themselves. They see the writing on the wall--the Senate is in serious jeopardy of falling to Democrats this November, perhaps even inevitable.
With only 7 months left of guaranteed control of the chamber necessary to confirm Trump's next picks for the Supreme Court, there's a growing push to force MAGA Justices Samuel Alito (age 76), Clarence Thomas (age 77), and John Roberts (age 71) to retire.
This would hand Trump three more Supreme Court Justice appointments and enshrine MAGA control over the Supreme Court for at least the next 40 years:

To accomplish this, MAGA would use the so-called "nuclear option"--a change of Senate rules that allows the appointment of Supreme Court justices via a simple majority vote rather than the 60 vote threshold historically used to confirm justices.
Mitch McConnell used the nuclear option for Trump's appointments of Gorsuch, Kavanaugh, and Coney Barrett. Prior to that, the nuclear option had never been used before in American history for a Supreme Court Justice confirmation. We have seen and felt the consequences of those actions: Roe v. Wade overturned. The Voting Rights Act gutted. Trump handed criminal immunity. The Clean Air and Water Acts gutted.
We cannot endure the hell of another 40 years of a MAGA controlled Supreme Court. We cannot allow Donald Trump, a president who has won both of his elections by historically slim margins, to single-handedly pack this court and dictate the next 4 decades of American history.
That's why we're pushing for Democrats to use a nuclear option of their own--to reform and rebalance the Supreme Court by expanding the amount of justices on the court. This is the only way for Democrats to stop the hell to come. The Constitution gives us that power. Congress has changed the number of justices seven times. No amendment is required.
But for this to become a reality, Democrats need our help. We need to win back control of the House, Senate, and White House by 2028. That's why Defend Our Courts will be fighting for Democrats across the map in hotly contested House and Senate races this November.
This fight is necessary. Unpacking the court is non-negotiable. It must happen, and we need your support to make it a reality: [It's time for Democrats to use the nuclear option and save the country from 40 years of hell. | Peter,
There is a stark difference between a Maine work ethic and a Washington political stunt.
The Radical Left's poster boy, Graham Platner, has plenty of time to pose for magazine covers and sit for glowing interviews with the New York Times.
Why? Because he simply isn't working.
He claims to be a "working-class oyster farmer," but the reality is far different. For the past decade, Platner has not held a full-time job. He has been passively growing oysters and enjoying a leisurely life, all while Chuck Schumer and Elizabeth Warren prop him up as their handpicked candidate to flip Maine blue. Now, he is bending the truth in glossy photo shoots, trying to convince voters that he will work hard for our state.
Mainers know what real hard work looks like.
Compare Platner's record to Susan Collins'. Susan has never missed a roll call vote. She has never taken a sick day. She has never stopped fighting for Maine's interests in Washington.
It is glaringly evident that Graham Platner lacks the work ethic that defines our state. If Schumer's millions successfully buy this seat, Maine will be represented by a part-time politician who cares more about his media profile than our communities.
We cannot let the Radical Left deceive Maine voters with a fabricated image. We need the resources to expose Platner's true record before it is too late.
[Can you chip in right now to help us fight back and keep a true, hardworking champion in the Senate?](https://trk.email.goprelease.)

## Trump Warns Israel on Iran Strikes
President Trump told reporters Monday that he warned Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu he could soon be [fighting alone](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO3CAQhJ8Gd5wwYDAFRaTIUoo_bUprMeu7TbCxgDvr3j7yVenTrfaTZj7Nr6_5CyjRfv8JG_q25nnHsyZsDcvnXAqeZy7bAhXrUSDClvMshTRcGC7cHIHSe9Zd9CuiRNWh7-0onHPGjN3DDyOOUYsl6BgVokNwVvSrHUIIfbChI3-lCSNcL4TV4830MGjneotxCWocmBYYqeVy-51pbw9c0zu_sNyWvHXJP1o7KlPfmJyYnCAsl_bFmJx-7A3LDo3yDonJKdEL-fOI0LAyOVGBnf_741QLYOIf0ApE5LUV-oOVt_LcjqtDTRSZ-t4rZayWWnXFx-OklKgay7S4b0Dp49b-a9CXl38DAAD__3pLi8c) against Iran, after the two countries exchanged fire for the first time since their April ceasefire. Iran fired nearly [30 ballistic missiles](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOwyAQBNCvwV2s9UKwKSiucZdrr7QW2DicsLEwCsrfn5JfuG6kkZ4083NbbhRT3Ndv2tjWe152bmfiWrl8oi_cWi6bp5PPo1CgLecFAfUF9AXMEiim16K6YO_MyLJjO4wTGGO0nrqHVQ4GI-VVTlqSGohJouYREF1wE7ku2rcGGswAMKqp1wNdlTHDyME7OV2FAg6x5tL_5rjXB9_TKz-59D5vXbKPWo9TyC-Bs8C5tdY759-dwPm9QOCc4pMFzj69eF_XEY-1dsWGo8WU4qlHoWDdKKaPWP91w9PiXwAAAP__qJ5w_A) at Israel on Sunday night after an Israeli strike on a Hezbollah headquarters in Beirut. Israel struck back at an Iranian petrochemical plant and air defenses, giving Washington what Trump called "very late notice." Both sides [halted attacks](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL-urCAYxJ8GOwx-qwgFxTZ2e9tbGpRP5V7-GMAl-_Yn7iucbpLfZDIzf1_zS1tnw_5He1Rli3PAmh2Wgukr14S1xuRXnTGfSRvtY5yBAaeMUyZno637zH1j1IYI-GhQdaNgUkrORXMoGCUzQhs2LFziKNZeDBtfxh66buEGG6vuNMaZ7Bgbe9HyTg-9lN2IZl0eYiA9Q2NLTO2_aEM5cHOf-MbUrtE3Th2lnJk8ngQmAlOttfU53IzAhIFemcB0L7lhTM4QmEq6_ElzSde-OzS0RJrQBmoDDVh0-Ojjovk22P-YaQzUJh0ITDrR5xMGHhdokjJntc7ZzEfSs91r676Vyq9-fCv4CQAA__-OJIg5) by Monday. Trump said the two countries are "very close" to a peace deal.
## Flesh-Eating Parasite Spreads in Texas
The USDA confirmed new cases of the flesh-eating screwworm parasite in Texas on Monday, with Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins calling it "just a little pest" that can be treated. Watch [Rollins talk about the screwworm](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykUL1uwyAYfBq8YWFs8zMwdPGWrh2tD_gc02ATAQ3K21fJ0BfocjrppPv7uqwXCDGc10840NQtrSe2ErFWzG_qMraW8uGgYLln8HCktHLGBWWCMr16CPG5Tp03GyLHsUMzSMW01kKobjdWjfO8KbQKuJMCrZZy3tg2c4QZ2dQF83JjgumBMTmpXgwwT1oPEr2zo5rJxNCHmnL_ncJZd9ziMz0w9y4dXTR7rfdCxg_CF8KX1lrvTuteIuHLI3hMhC-vCMIX9gZF-PJTPNCCLmOF_KQ2p3RDmlOM4Sw0nfRveaENY6QWKdiItCZqESqteyjUgrv1ez1il42_txBjKEKSiV0PCPFdsP7r1YfhvwEAAP__rX6M5A). However, about 100 ranchers [packed a state briefing](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFurDAQBuDTQGdkjDG4cPEaun1tSmTsYXFkMBkPS_b2EatoL5Duk2Y0-uf_uI03G2LY7v_tCobmNG5w5ghEgC86hPNMuDqbIe9ovV1TGgUXinHFuB69DfE5ytKbGUBAU4Kpu55rrZXqy8WItpWdmr2eJug7OTvnZCsa27Qw625WZTDXNa64rjnvZF-p2rZS67oD76ambwvJwQdKWH2msNECc3ymB2Dl0lpGsxDtuWj-FWIoxHCeZ3XkK_k1LsRwsRADpZ390iIFF-Hi-4_-WlngicAmIArbnaUD2QLoGcG3zQzt5hbAzL4OyBTSxo7sLbOZvTtiCHTglks0fj9DjCGrrpD8vtoQX2npTxU_jPgJAAD___fPkyU) demanding faster federal action, as experts warned the outbreak could cost Texas $1.8 billion and tighten a national herd already at its lowest count in 75 years. Florida [blocked livestock imports](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2ypCAQhZ8GMyxkGJCAYBOz2XRDq4VWewfFAnasefstJ7j3AW7S1cGp7_z8eYwPoEj78hs2dHVO445niVgr5s_rM55nypuHguXIEGBLaZRCai40F3YMQPE9qia4GVHirUHXmV5Ya7Xum9V1Jng7GTsrazSiUdh1k-g1Aoqg7lND7qIJLWwnhFF9qzu4K2s7g8FPt_7OlMBANeX2b6K9rjjHd3phbn3amujWWo_Cbr-YHJgczvNsfST_TDnCHtIlYnK4qjA5zDFlCsDkcHkyOYivM0csK0eotC_8gAyFKhZeDshPjhvmBXf_5vlfRE47_yY12YXjpBipaMOUWDag-MlWfzToy8n_AQAA__8Rm4rP) from infested zones, and Canada imposed its own restrictions on Texas cattle. Gov. Greg Abbott issued a [disaster proclamation](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFugzAURb8GNiNjiMGDhy5s6doRGfuZODJ-yH6B5u-rpFJ_oNuVrnR1zv26zlcTYkjrp9lAk8c5wVkiEEF-R5vhPDFv1hQoezbObIiz4EIyLhlXszMhPue-dtoDCOhq0O0wcqWUlGN905fW-4G3HrwRcmxF1ym7jIvzIPnSC1sH_VrjkquW86EfG9maS69UO4CzSzdeqp6DC4S5uWNIdAMfn3hAbixuddQ3or1U3UclpkpMKx4NwbcpzYpHJaaXQyWmHQv9tpATZmaWBYlYKOUBhSU42Yk5Ovbny1wophBktme00WyGAiYWErs_ErAXcp21288QYyhyqHq-bibENxT968lDi58AAAD__zu7i2w) as the government pledged nearly $1 billion to fight the outbreak.
## Prada Designs NASA's Moon Suit
Italian fashion house Prada and Axiom Space [unveiled the inner layer](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO8yAQhJ_G7rAwtrEpKP7GXf72SmsDS7InDBaQkLz9Kb5HuG6lb2c0M1-X7QLkKdz-w466uLgFrNljKZjO0ySsNabdQMZ8JLCwx7gJLiTjknG1WSD_3sbWaococGhR9_PClVJSLu1d9_Y6TcM8LNYYJyfkbhZCTdcRuHUAqiX9ceOSq57zeVw62cM0KtXPaM11WKZm5GipxNR9Rwrljs6_4xNTZ-Leen0v5cjN8K8RayPWWmsHL4p7PsDg56URa0KPkLER64nYydjZhj3CE8kzCgET8_DGxKJjAV-F3TAw_wiQfgX5QaVN2h6VvKcs52bktx3In0HKn9Z7avETAAD__-IWh2E) of the spacesuit NASA astronauts will wear when they walk on the moon for the first time in more than 50 years. The form-fitting undergarment [circulates cold water](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkb2upDAMhZ8GOo9CBgIUFNvQ3W23RL7BDL7KD0rMMLz9CvYRtjvS8TnyZ__5mr6QHYfXb_Q0yBKnQEd2JELpljbRccTkLWbKW8IZfYyTVtqAMqD6aUZ251SX87AQaXqWNFRtp_q-N6Yr12F54reutLZN1Syt6qnplsooY9vGmsbokoerTRnVV0q1dfcwFTZ131ctzfb72TVFrWhmienxEznISos745vSw0ZfumEV2XLx_FXosdDjcRyPvKGlyy30eGugz-ZiQuEYCj2uu8cAt7M4fq1S6JElw5vSCUhZVhK26NwJmyPMHF5wowOGGfDD0cPPngUSvQkdzSArQZbTcV7BxngdFPLOApiEPGfALCmGHSXDwc7BQZhgDzOlK8vp3zZ3JIa7zscYyjTM2zXP2bRFrV4e2d3Y8l-_eg_6bwAAAP__7Pyw-Q) through tubes to keep astronauts cool during eight-hour moonwalks at the lunar South Pole, with a full backup system if the primary loop fails. The design was revealed at a flagship Prada store in New York City. [Watch the suit in action.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGOgyAURb8GdxhERFmwmI27znaW5hWe9TUoBmiZ_v2k_YXZ3eQmJyfn57JcgAIdt2_Y0ZY1LgfWHLAUTJ_pEtYa0-4gYz4TeNhjXKSQmgvNhVk8UHgtqvF2RZTYN2i7cRLGGK2nZrNqRURj1qEf5CDBe-VcB8qN0Iurwa4h-6YJLUwnxKimVncwKGO6Eb279tPAlEBPJab2HukoG67hFZ-YWhf3JtitlDOz_ovJmcm51trWBOF9Mjk_yWNkcv6YcxdDgGtMUDDzSmXj8Etx5_kEh_lBhd8fB_K3D5Nzk6w_K4VAWY9MidsO9OE25V-lnlb-BQAA__8nV36l) NASA is targeting early 2028 for the Artemis IV mission. | | | | | [**Demand Reversal of "Special Forever Immunity" for Trump and Family **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T36a20f3b-a2c4-4ff8-b1a0-3d39aec7c572/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9a58f992-45e3-41ad-a54c-0388879a711b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) The rest of us pay our taxes. The rest of us can be audited. The rest of us have to follow the rules. **So why the hell should Donald Trump _and his family_ get [special treatment](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tec32bc9b-bb70-48a1-94a3-0c92e5672ad3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)? ** Yes, Trump and his family have apparently given [special protection](https://default.salsalabs.org/T78b1fb57-ae9b-4d91-bd35-5881e5840aa9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) from further IRS investigations as part of a deal between Donald Trump and Donald Trump. That's right --** Donald Trump essentially ordered federal officials who report to Donald Trump to give immunity to Donald Trump.** Presumably beause Donald Trump knows that Donald Trump is guilty as hell? [We can stop this](https://default.salsalabs.org/T146e0576-d5d5-4840-9e50-e71fa26f4596/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). And with enough pressure from the people, we will, [just like the $1.8 billion slush fund](https://default.salsalabs.org/T566bdd40-d813-4050-bd72-5eb80a6b89db/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) (keep an eye on that too, of course, and don't let these crooks try and slip it by again). If ordinary Americans can be audited, investigated, and held accountable, then the same rules should apply to Trump.

[**Add your name: "Hell No to Special Tax Immunity for Trump & Family"**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb1944912-83b7-4ffe-a666-fc5aa23dd082/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

## Screwworm Infection Spreads
The [New World screwworm](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGS2yAQhp8GdXgWjMAUFGnoLm1KzUosZyZYOICP09tn5CIvkGa32dnv__5fH8sHppz2z5_4INe_Y1l2Gi1T71SXtlUao9RHe1bC0Dpt9z_rhvsiQWoOmoNdAqZ8LGoKboVgxUROmJsAkFbY6e5gNmbeVrzZiEHgjDcT7FXFSNGsQm9Tcucz0GCFADHri9ZRK1wVmKtVhIopoJB6qZd-p07f2GI-yhfVy1YeU3b33p-NXX8w6Zn0Y4zLq2EvAY_zgEnfeqkHk_40Oxf2VHYm_cll0sN73Jj0rxaQ7zT4KDUH_k-fx3zwN5mXV18r4W8mvQU1GwkawDDpp-rCc6ScU9OGKfh8YMrvhP3_ev1y8m8AAAD__6tai4c) has now been confirmed in five U.S. cases, with the USDA announcing three new detections Monday—a calf in La Salle County, a goat in Gillespie County, and a dog whose owner lives in Lea County, New Mexico, making it the first confirmed case outside Texas. The [parasitic fly](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDHO4yAUhE-DO1sPTLApKLZxl223tJ7hOSBhkwUUktuvnGIv8Lcz0sx88-e-3jHEcD5-40Gmvve0ntRKpFopr8Vmai3lozwzoSuVrP-7WTxXAUL1oHrQq8MQP6vsnNnAad6R4dPMAYTmuvNGzngDyzeSEixJu41i1Nu43ZSbcdLYBXOFgQLNOfCbGpTalcRNwjRqSSiZBHKhpjxUT5XeWPb4SS_Kg01HF42v9VnY-IuJhYmltTZ80Kd0uUwsFw4TS7GBTktMLJhrsJEusfpM1FssVPr_rL1N5x7yQa7_lvV85iMIENPg6xG7bNyzhRhDUROT8DgwxO-S-rP_Xkb8CwAA___3coXg) lays eggs in open wounds of living warm-blooded animals. Larvae then burrow into healthy tissue, causing wounds that can become life-threatening without treatment. The original outbreak was confirmed on June 3 in Zavala County in South Texas. The New Mexico case, roughly 400 miles from Zavala County, was initially reported by a Texas veterinarian before the USDA reclassified the animal's location. USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins said [the U.S. food supply is not at risk](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGu4yAQBdCvwR3WgDEJBcU27rLtlhYexjFabLzAhuTvn5Li_cBrphnpXN375zbfXIjhuP92O9n6XNN8UCuRaqU8F8zUWsp7OTM5Xyrh9m9Bd8wSpOagOZjZuxBfs-q8XcAb0ZEVl6sAkEaYbrOEbnQLCmc8Gom00jrqAZS64qBwhC7YNwYajBAgRt1rvWrlFgWXwShyiikgH2rKfd2o0tOVNb7Sg3KPae-i3Wo9Cxt-MTkxObXWejwWfD-ZnN42kxN8zpXJ6QPw72YcXaHC15Q8L__PM774klP6SzynGMNR-q3uscvWny3EGIq-MAX33YX4ia8_G-1h5VcAAAD__zjGggM) and pledged more than $1 billion to push the pest back into Mexico. The USDA is currently releasing about 10 million sterile flies weekly over affected areas, with aerial dispersal flights set to begin Tuesday from Moore Air Base in Edinburg. President Trump also appointed Texas A&M Regent John Bellinger as senior adviser for screwworm preparedness.
## West Texas Drug Ring Busted
An 18-month multiagency operation in San Angelo ended with [48 suspects charged](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGStCAUhE-jGRYgg0NA8Cdm86cbWk94jlShuPB2GG-_5Vxhsw66u7q_r8f0gBDD_vwPG1p6L2nasZaIRJin4jLWmvJWjozgC6Fbv2cH-yS51Ixrxs3kIcRzUq23M_dGtGjFcBecSyNMu9pezwgKQcIN1YBOLmJRvr_B4AZtZtMGe5VxzY0QXNx0p_WiFcyKD71RCKpRHH2glDtakfANZYlnemHuXNraaFeiozT9v0aOjRxrrd2S3uq6cRkaOV6ykeMnytKBGSiknbm0uzWxF8SIJ1N3Vn7KgY4KcyvkJ3q24E6wn5FtSGubrT9qiDEUPTSKPzcI8TOB_gbuZeVvAAAA__-ixIWy) for trafficking fentanyl, meth, cocaine, and heroin into Concho Valley communities. "Operation Concho Valley Shakedown" [seized nearly 80 pounds](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDHO4yAUhE-DOyzABOyCYht32XZL6xmebSQMXiBxktOvkmhP8JczGs03mj_X6Qo--Lj-hh1NfSxpiniWgLVinorNeJ4p7-XICK5UtNvf2UKcBBOKMkXZMDnw4TnJxpmZuYE3aLjuOWNi4EOzGa16pi30i9Bc9nrmUoO1Xceckhc9YOPNu4wpNnDO-EW1Si1KwiyZ7gaJIIlk6HxNua0bVnxAWcIz3TG3Nu1NMFutRyHdLyJGIsbzPFubot3SHULA55Z2PGDFd5iI0Wa_IxFjSBYC_a_SgRmqT5HaDfKKhbr0wlhoQf_CQntGj3SLrtC0UJdva6E-0i-Gfjkfm2YfVyLGJht3nD4EX5Qmkq07-PCZW3928t2IfwEAAP__wpmUgQ) of drugs. Twenty-four suspects were federally indicted on May 13; a coordinated sweep completed the remaining arrests. The operation was led by the FBI, the DEA, and the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Northern District of Texas, alongside dozens of state and local agencies. Investigators [targeted a network](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGStCAUhE-jGRYgg0NA8Cdm86cbWk94jlShuPB2GG-_5Vxhsw66u7q_r8f0gBDD_vwPG1p6L2nasZaIRJin4jLWmvJWjozgC6Fbv2cH-yS51Ixrxs3kIcRzUq23M_dGtGjFcBecSyNMu9pezwgKQcIN1YBOLmJRvr_B4AZtZtMGe5VxzY0QXNx0p_WiFcyKD71RCKpRHH2glDtakfANZYlnemHuXNraaFeiozT9v0aOjRxrrd2S3uq6cRkaOV6ykeMnytKBGSiknbm0uzWxF8SIJ1N3Vn7KgY4KcyvkJ3q24E6wn5FtSGubrT9qiDEUPTSKPzcI8TOB_gbuZeVvAAAA__-ixIWy) importing narcotics into West Texas communities for years.
## Judge Rules Sorsby Can Play for Now
A Lubbock judge granted Texas Tech quarterback Brendan Sorsby a [temporary injunction Monday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGutCAUhJ8GOwwcWdSC4m_s9m9vaQ5yVBIUF8i6vv2N-wq3n8zM9_08xyf64PflP25kymeO405nDlQKpTFPic4zpi0fidDlQtP6shPuIwjQXGgu-tGhD9eoKmescL2syMi2k0JAL_tqNQ1I2yE4cI1oWmfFAzqERiqSnWwervLmLhNa9FIK-dC11rNWaJVom14RKqYEOV9iqstKhT6Y53DFN6V6ilsVzFrKkVnzj8HAYDjPs55szkdMJd8JBsMUQ6CF-BxjsRgCg-GmZDDYRLvDneeYsr34knAv5PgXj4JfvPWhXPy7ym98_rJ8nxD5gpu9xTEYqmTccfoQfNYtU2LZ0IfvufI3pW8DvwEAAP__0CqM4Q), ordering the NCAA to declare him eligible for the 2026 season. Sorsby was ruled permanently ineligible after court documents revealed he placed thousands of bets totaling at least $90,000 across multiple sportsbooks over four years--including bets on Indiana games while he was a Hoosiers freshman. Judge Ken Curry ruled he would suffer "irreparable injury" if blocked from playing. He must sit out [the Red Raiders' first two games](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO3CAURb8Gd4weLIOHgiIN3aZNaT3g2UOEwQEyXv99NPmFra90dc759bl8YsqpbD9xJzu-1roUOnumMagtPTQ6z9r2fjTC2AeF5x8fsCwSpOagOZglYsrXoqZoPUQjJrJifggAaYSZnlaIGfC-zuRRPYSSfn0ED-DvRj_uGGBK9n0GGowQIO76pvWqFXoF84dRhIopoJhGbbfxpEFf2Nd81Re1W6j7lO1zjKOzjx9MOibdeZ436kd5j0y6UHOmjfha6_CYM5Ouj9ouJt3CpEuRSacMAIh5ZtL5RiVi4b227i--NSyDIk_l998SRqqFvzovAZFTTlvymfiR8eJvhanZeJwp59T1zBRsO6b8n3F8r-zLyn8BAAD__-n2jb0). subject: Not just “that gay politician”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action
body:
| This race is bigger than any one of us, Peter.
---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2453%2E259176%2EjcN04H) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2453%2E259176%2EjcN04H)_

[](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11027?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.09_Craig-Gay-Politician_B1_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=4&akid=2453%2E259176%2EjcN04H) Peter, I’m a gay woman running for U.S. Senate — there’s no hiding that core part of who I am. That being said, I’ve never run my campaigns on identity politics. I focus my attention on what’s important in my constituents’ lives. And I’ve always talked about my own family like any other politician would — about how important my wife and my four sons are to me, and how fighting for the right to even be a family has shaped my life experience. As a public figure, I feel like I have to come out repeatedly — even just talking about my family. **Honestly, it gets exhausting. I’m not running to be "that gay politician" from Minnesota.** I'm running for the Minnesotans who are rationing insulin because they can't afford it. For the seniors who worked their whole lives and deserve to retire with dignity. For the families who are doing everything right and still can't get ahead — because the system is rigged in favor of those at the top. But I'd be less than honest if I said my life experience hadn't shaped who I am as a candidate, and as a person. Look, when my son Josh was little, I went through a years-long legal battle — with a judge writing that having two moms wasn’t in the “best interests” of any child. Just weeks after my wife Cheryl and I got married, Proposition 8 was passed in California, outlawing same-sex marriage and jeopardizing our union, along with 18,000 others. Last year, the Supreme Court was considering taking up a case that could overturn the landmark case that legalized same-sex marriage across the country. For me, this fight is personal. And I’ve learned to not give up the moment things get tough. Often, someone will stop me at an event or the grocery store and quietly tell me they are a Republican and their child is gay. And they appreciate the example I’m setting for their kids — even from across the aisle. See — representation really does matter. If elected, I’d make history as the first LGBTQ+ member to represent Minnesota in the U.S. Senate. **That’s a big deal for queer folks everywhere who have never seen someone like them have a seat at the table.** But I can’t win this race alone, Peter. We still need to raise another $27,233 this week to hit our big goal, and if we fall short, we’ll have to make some cuts at a crucial moment in this race. [**So please, will you split a donation between me and Blue Amp Action before midnight to help me make history as the first lesbian woman to represent Minnesota in the U.S. Senate?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11027?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.09_Craig-Gay-Politician_B1_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=5&akid=2453%2E259176%2EjcN04H) _If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Angie Craig and Blue Amp Action will go through immediately:_ | [DONATE $10 >>](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11028?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.09_Craig-Gay-Politician_B1_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=6&akid=2453%2E259176%2EjcN04H)

The U.S. Supreme Court voted 6-3 to allow Alabama to use its 2023 congressional map for the August special primary, despite lower courts repeatedly ruling that the map intentionally discriminates against Black voters. The decision follows the Court's recent ruling that raised the legal standard for proving voting rights violations, and it is expected to benefit Republicans by making Alabama's 2nd Congressional District more favorable to their party. Dissenting Justice Sonia Sotomayor warned that the ruling undermines voting rights protections and could lead to a "chaotic election."

Severe thunderstorms swept across Central Alabama on June 1, causing widespread power outages, downed trees, blocked roads, and damage to homes and vehicles in dozens of communities. More than 77,000 Alabama Power customers lost electricity as emergency crews responded to storm-related incidents across the region, though no widespread serious injuries were reported. The storms highlighted the need for stronger infrastructure investments, including improvements to power systems, roadways, and emergency preparedness measures that can help communities better withstand severe weather and recover more quickly after natural disasters.

# One Last Thought Until Next Week
---
| | |
---

When we started all of this, we came up with a four-phase plan:
Phase 1: Gather information on the district. This involved not only analytical research into the district but also visiting all 11 counties and talking to people about what they needed.

Phase 2: Meeting with democratic organizations in the district. This involved assessing the capacity of the existing party infrastructure to support a campaign.

Phase 3: Engage those party organizations to build a campaign network. This would include hiring essential professional staff.

Phase 4: Move outside the democratic organizations. Engaging independents and swayable Republicans in the run-up to the general election.
We are currently transitioning from Phase 3 to Phase 4 and working across all 11 counties. We have many great volunteers and hired professional staff with plans to bring on a few more essential staff members soon. We are beginning to place social media ad buys and stepping up our fundraising efforts to support this work. We are also in the final stages of planning town hall meetings and will make some announcements about them soon.
This week, I will send an email outlining specific ways you can support the campaign. Keep an eye out for that email, give it a read, and if you can help with any of the areas listed, we would really appreciate it.
We are gaining momentum across the district as we move ahead. We're making plans for the final run to the finish line in November. Your support has been great, and we're really looking forward to the next five months.
We are 147 days away from the general election.

We'll talk soon,

Lee

# Team TFVC at RPT
| |
---
|
---
Team TFVC has arrived in Houston** for the Republican Party of Texas (RPT) State Convention**, where the delegates shape the platform and set the legislative priorities! Here’s your sneak peek into what to expect from Team TFVC this week! **First, we have already hit the ground running!** Yesterday, TFVC Political Director Emily Cameron and President Rebecca Hardy testified in the HHS Subcommittee of the Platform Committee. Today, we have been invited to testify as **subject matter experts** by the Legislative Priorities Committee to ensure that the party is committed to finally **ending vaccine mandates for our healthcare workers, healthcare students, and patients**. We see a lot of friendly faces on both of these committees which is a reminder that our _community outreach work is just as crucial as our legislative relationships_. The future of our movement is shaped by those who _show up and do the work_ , and we simply cannot express how amazing it is to lock arms with fellow advocates, coalition partners, and elected officials **who are here with us** , ready to spread the message of vaccine choice throughout the convention.
Second, starting today, our team of staff and exceptional volunteers will be **setting up our revamped and interactive booth** in the convention exhibit hall to promote TFVC's mission to the expected 10,000 convention attendees! **RPT Attendees:** Make the TFVC Booth (#627 on the right-hand side, facing the Super Aisle) one of your first stops when you get to convention! We'll have plenty of freebies, special discounts, and exclusive opportunities, including a **special Meet & Greet with Dr. Mary Talley Bowden** at 1:30pm on Thursday. **And lastly, make sure you are following us on our social media channels for updates throughout this pivotal week!**

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. subject: We won. They tried to erase us. Here's what happened.
body:
The Milwaukee law firm hired to knock the Wisconsin Green Party off the 2026 ballot... | | |
###
#
[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.lmpSTrE-G07FKUPTdpC9IZjZvXgsFb7Wbw8hteHra_Ae6t1NWHmpL0J4UlpdazKvCYWwO3qNgdG_zhsfMDFhgZqLBdrcdq6meN0gCt6752ZX2xrHWB2V4Fn1NUFBOCl-suitSs33xI1dkdhLpmVyvXSQ3sGOZpgFqT-ltBixrd84u18atlAvCRQr3sKZKelHGHlDBVyyTXdi1qHB4_7Wj7xLRJnOpD2ktxTN016pCbeQmn1DuSl28nnxPe0x-mfDQU_dtMNDHZ5TjfeDNrX-ynF_iDv5AnbKl_CJmWh1Cup_uLHejh43_FZxNb3cXuev/4rc/40STZ1xMSNqPZJOQCEOxNg/h0/h001.VsdfAIWEJQSPl57bLDYtAAuzf3kcuAxPn0PgYkT56S8)**** Friend, This morning, the lawyers backed down. The Milwaukee law firm hired to knock the Wisconsin Green Party off the 2026 ballot, Halling & Cayo S.C., representing a challenger named Gregory Walz-Chojnack, notified the Wisconsin Elections Commission that they are **withdrawing their challenge** to my nomination papers. We won. But let's be clear about what just happened, let’s also look at who was behind it. **Democrats hired lawyers to eliminate your choices in November.** They couldn't find a single fraudulent signature. They couldn't name one unqualified voter. They couldn't identify a single signer who was confused or misled. So they threw hypertechnical legal garbage at the Wisconsin Elections Commission and hoped nobody would fight back. We fought back. Over a single weekend — while the Commission was closed — my legal team assembled sworn affidavits from 13 circulators across Wisconsin, filed a comprehensive verified response, and dismantled every argument they had. By Monday morning, the challenge was dead. **This is not the first time.**
* In **2016** , Democrats challenged **Jill Stein's** Wisconsin ballot access.
* In **2020** , they succeeded in knocking **Howie Hawkins** off the Wisconsin ballot entirely.
* In **2026** , they came for us.

The Democratic Party calls itself the party of democracy. Then it hires lawyers to make sure you can't vote for anyone but them. Wisconsin voters deserve to know that and remember it in November. **Here's what they were really afraid of:** My presence on the November ballot doesn't just give Wisconsin voters a genuine choice this year. A strong Green Party showing in the Secretary of State race **locks in automatic Wisconsin ballot access for the Green Party in the 2028 presidential election cycle.** They knew that. That's why they filed on a Friday. That's why they gave us 72 hours to respond over a weekend. That's why they hired the lawyers. It was a calculated ambush. It failed. **Now we need your help.** Every dollar we spent on this fight was a dollar we couldn't spend talking to voters. We won the battle — but the war is November 3rd, and we're running a 100% grassroots campaign with no corporate money and no party machine behind us. If you're angry about what the Democratic Party just tried to do, show it. **** [**Donate today at PeteKaras.com!**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.lmpSTrE-G07FKUPTdpC9IVfrBwzHTTUAy-yX1MT9ehGx712NqJQWVtDq_qpPhUlVFIfnR_gCPNT7PsP-l11Y9p65heIP0rOok0dtHfgPM9dAQY8oc6btEBRNWgRrBOfqDDckcPNGy8xRdL3uQ8Xk79ZDrDhYfZfso9engkQTJM5w_aMf_Q0kzN_FaYpWQS23zp8JbKXTfuoneO3qJLcnIMmWHgqaNbJr_lozsVd5t4F_GFAD4SCeKZJrs1u2ynI_DIDOxvXt22cFdUBZY3IeUU32QHV4CwymcAJMawKtRls-GO1vAZp6XX3eg2qvtIhaJEsfI9JLUQaBKtiXkvEanw/4rc/40STZ1xMSNqPZJOQCEOxNg/h1/h001.3KMcanWfFP0ByCqw42hvamf7lEfhKfmwvbkxJqFVqYo)
[****](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.C7dr4qDrCqRF_FlXMupJsZUh-FzgRmgubdExzYYOUuIhFXIkX23tBdH_bf8IMIZne4Y67OAshu8vlCEiHSZk2B-nA_pxJCq3em243JAQlLNAST7dUz1iduHJ2198rYi5X5_kvySFOqFQzef_aWCVbI7ts_OxmJFwBdgi45wFjZ5I7MHtzF3zcukuFxLqFivhAsabPph4VGmvGirnNOZDQgxgAqwXCF-EQhrP5W039iXmzqH8SQukbYtpX60HHsiu_k9CZKYlMEYUqVzrajVHSw_V-F2H9n-AhUDZp5TEiAw_V9056BoM9mSfn7qthMwW/4rc/40STZ1xMSNqPZJOQCEOxNg/h2/h001.7a4HT3_8aEdefqkn3Ug3ODz-RIZ7QyXJVovy_AM97IU) Every dollar helps. Every share helps. Every conversation with a neighbor helps. We're still standing. We're still on the ballot. And we're going all the way to November. For democracy — real democracy, \- Pete

# Tuesday, June 9, 2026
---
| This sponsored message from Just The Truth is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/tEI7G7qryUZFdUD8gqlq9DCdiqf5JI%2FhfDKOZtn9KUQUEtWEbTQu%2Fhu6fB7T%0AamiOKq0FIfqifR8pvwsgMU1g3JW5a0tWKx143qCINMQ%2B4%2FWG0XMW4jOdMfCF%0AJUOC%2FzoH436%2B5u6UFyseHPPaJBqDz8aKK6GvlASW2vuy%2FCjMWQNyQFvmzxCu%0AC2tN9qqHmyKQ%2FuuwCcmFfO6Ct4DxnHvuzQ%3D%3D%0A/3b9be192acaaed2d)Dear Friend,Have you noticed how hard it is to make sense of arguments today?Confident claims, especially with talking heads on television... quick reactions in comments online... everyone with strong opinions but not always clear thinking.That’s why we put together a **free Logic and Rhetoric Guide** —to help you think more clearly, evaluate the various opinions you hear and read daily, and make stronger, more persuasive arguments.**You can download your free Logic and Rhetoric Guide here:**[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/logic-rhetoric-study-guide**](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/5GAnq45Zha2z92m%2FAHK7w%2FmV5LnCak%2FXqDU4raclT5z8QxS4iFC9ChWEBtXs%0AmzrUiXCKN6KLXxI4%2B8wrKi91ulxycEpjSC%2FzMSM%2BCSi%2BRDSCCnLt66Iem6br%0AHElQA5%2FeKtguKCLgdUJLLl2MElkjVM4uxzo%2FiJsVYenh4j%2BZr3ZXGzQ7sweh%0ABvmW1uew3e2zg%2FOyYD68ttO8GkhX8zlAWw%3D%3D%0A/d30c893a65ecee08) Inside, you’ll discover how to:
* Recognize when an argument is sound, or when it falls apart
* Distinguish facts from opinions and emotional appeals
* Think more clearly before reacting
* Express your ideas more clearly and persuasively

In short, your guide will help you do something that’s becoming increasingly rare: **Think clearly—and speak with confidence.** And it’s not just theory, although there’s a lot of that in the guide.These are practical tools you can start using right away—in conversations, while watching the news, and in daily decisions.**The guide is completely free, and you can read it at your own pace.** And, if you want to go deeper, you can continue learning in Hillsdale College’s full FREE online course, **“Classical Logic and Rhetoric.”** Trust me, the guide becomes even more helpful when you see these ideas explained by a Hillsdale faculty member in the full course.**So, download your free Logic and Rhetoric Guide now:**[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/logic-rhetoric-study-guide**](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/ts2imvgUGRjh6KYWXFnrd%2Fk2CvF7P%2F5N4F6GiuNnJN2zdVxU1Yjhb5RRhiH0%0Ai9F%2B2EU0uk%2FlXAOIa6sK4MoRP0AYMzw9ahwgVkuFz8caEjYmWwe9WiGWAVor%0AmHuIccEXIrD%2BO4q6vyQa9NKO%2FX6yR8goCLZggi9QeHtydDW%2F8T%2F7uf5lyW2w%0AnBT073hUVlJZJ%2BKUl0%2FUcTgDHPytzRkd6Q%3D%3D%0A/bc09f5f355320194) It’s our gift to you. Part of our educational mission is to help more and more people understand what’s true and communicate it clearly.We hope you find it helpful.Warm regards,Bill Gray, ‘01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College**P.S.** This short guide is a simple way to sharpen your thinking and improve your communication right away. # Conforti Grassroots Newsletter
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

Welcome to our interactive grassroots newsletter. As we approach the Midterm Election 2026, this newsletter is dedicated to keeping the hardworking constituents of Illinois' 6th Congressional District informed and engaged.

Our campaign is built on a "district-first" mentality. We are committed to prioritizing your needs, focusing on fundamental ideals of sensible solutions and open dialogue. Through this newsletter, we will provide you with regular updates on policy, campaign events, and current community events happening right here in our district.
Click the button below to make a donation today. Your donations are what makes this possible.
---
| | [DONATE](https://us.list-manage.com/10V83dQDliT?e=25f4fa3311&c2id=7b058fb5598c3e136d157ed790328086)
---
| |
---
| |
## Kitchen Table Tuesday.
The Conforti Brief.
District-First Events.
---
| |
### Educate. Inform. Invite.
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
# Kitchen Table Tuesday
---
| | **Educating and connecting** with voters on important issues.
---
| | |
---
| | I know how frustrating and stressful it is for families who are struggling to make ends meet in our current economic climate. Sadly, Illinois has been **losing industry and jobs at a quickening pace** , a crisis that is forcing families to deplete their savings just to stay afloat. We cannot allow this decline to continue unchecked. The reality is: a strong local economy relies on strong local production, and more industry leads directly to more jobs and higher-paying opportunities for hardworking Illinoisans.
.To turn this troubling trend around, my goal is to **stimulate the return of manufacturing to the 6th District** to provide immediate relief and get people back to work. By prioritizing American-made goods and incentivizing companies to build and operate right here in our communities, we can revitalize our local workforce. Restoring our manufacturing sector is the most effective, common-sense way to bring lasting financial stability and growth back to the families of our district.
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | |
## The Conforti Brief
---
| | **Informing voters** on current events and how Niki plans to help them once in office.
---
| | Securing Our Elections: A Federal Standard for Voter ID
.Recently, the Des Moines Register outlined the voting rules and ID requirements for Iowa's 2026 Election Day. Under Iowa law, voters are required to present a valid form of identification at the polls before they vote, such as a state driver's license or a U.S. passport. While states like Iowa are taking the lead in securing their elections, **Illinois voters and voters nationwide deserve that exact same level of confidence** when casting their ballots for federal office.
.In our everyday lives, we need a photo ID to buy cough syrup and to get on an airplane—we should also need a photo ID to vote. Unfortunately, **Democrats like Sean Casten have completely failed to secure our elections** , prioritizing partisan games and personal standing over common-sense security measures. While Casten and his allies continue to block safeguards that protect the integrity of your ballot, Niki Conforti will use her position in the U.S. House of Representatives to protect the ballot box for Illinoisans. Her goal is to push for federal legislation that implements the need for three forms of ID to register to vote, alongside a strict requirement for a photo ID at the polling booth.
.By implementing these basic, common-sense measures federally, the impact will be clear and immediate: it **ensures that only eligible voters are participating** in the democratic process. We must secure our federal elections, so they remain fair and truly representative of our hardworking citizens. Niki will confidently fight for these essential federal reforms in Washington to restore faith in our system and guarantee that every legal vote in Illinois is protected.

Stay informed on this issue—[**read the full breakdown here.**](https://us.list-manage.com/1Bq4acmwuM7?e=25f4fa3311&c2id=7b058fb5598c3e136d157ed790328086)

---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
# District-First
# Events
---

**Join the Conforti Campaign at the**Oak Lawn Fourth of July Parade!**
---
| |
---
| | Before sharing the details for the Oak Lawn Parade, we would like to invite you to our upcoming **Darien Town Hall Event**. Please join Niki Conforti, our team, and the broader community for this important event as we champion a 'district-first' approach.
* **Date:** Wednesday, June 17th

Multiple video recordings showed crowds ripping the Wembanyama jersey from the victim's torso as onlookers cheered the destruction, with similar incidents occurred at Bryant Park's public watch party. Police deploy riot control, arrest 21 fans amid assaults and weapon violations: NYPD made 21 arrests including charges for attacking officers, assault, weapon possession, menacing and obstructing police operations during crowd management efforts. Five officers sustained injuries while eight individuals faced formal charges and 13 received court summonses, as police worked to contain thousands of unhinged fans. Heightened security protocols prompted cancellation of downtown watch party due to presidential attendance The primary Garden-area viewing event was abandoned the day-of following security concerns related to President Donald Trump's arrival, redirecting crowds toward the Bryant Park location instead. Game 4 continues Wednesday evening at the Garden as Knicks pursue the franchise's first championship since 1973. Trump Draws Mixed Reaction at NBA Finals in NYC President Donald Trump attended Game 3 of the NBA Finals at Madison Square Garden Monday, where he was shown on the arena's big screen during the national anthem alongside granddaughter Kai Trump and Knicks owner James Dolan. The crowd 's response was notably divided -- boos mixed with cheers, a stark contrast to the enthusiastic reception he received at the College Football National Championship in Florida earlier this year. Trump 's appearance triggered an extensive security operation across Midtown Manhattan. Authorities closed several blocks around MSG to vehicles and pedestrians, while Secret Service, TSA, and NYPD screened attendees, resulting in significantly longer entry wait times. Nearby watch parties were canceled ahead of the game. NYPD cited security demands from the presidential visit, though MSG disputed that account, saying city officials -- not the Secret Service -- denied the necessary permits. ### June 9, 2026 Newsletter
---
| | Mom Life, Media, and America's Future
---
| |
---
| | For our milestone 250th episode, we could not have asked for a more perfect guest. Debbie Kraulidis sits down with Lara Trump — wife, mother, television host, political strategist, and member of one of the most recognized families in America — for a conversation as honest as it is inspiring. Lara opens up about meeting Eric Trump, raising children in the public eye, building a career without losing yourself, and navigating today's turbulent culture with grace, faith, and unshakeable purpose. This is not a polished talking-points interview. This is a real conversation between two women who love their families and love this country — and it shows. From the weight of public life to the quiet strength of motherhood, Lara shares the kind of personal insights you rarely hear. She talks about resilience, about raising kids when the stakes have never felt higher, and about why — at this moment in history — now is the time to celebrate this great nation like never before. 250 episodes. 250 years. One conversation you do not want to miss. Watch or listen now on [YouTube](https://momsforamerica.us/so/10PweT8oL/c?w=0wxy9-4x0D2O-Ei-QmC9b2pvXS130zDtdywNdJRW64c.), [Rumble](https://momsforamerica.us/so/10PweT8oL/c?w=8JNlGyN1RC43aTJ6s2rHCCN_PJDJX4NqGFvTzeybKMk.), [Spotify](https://momsforamerica.us/so/10PweT8oL/c?w=wgNkKIg9Bk2yPUkrPNZkaSwCNIRx4jxNBiRHSFyDho0.), or [Apple Podcast](https://momsforamerica.us/so/10PweT8oL/c?w=2KCNQyZeu5M9Dhxv9JJsaH5jPaGB7m8vgbSGZtMUYbI.) — and help us celebrate this extraordinary milestone.

## Honoring 250 Episodes While Celebrating 250 Years of Freedom
---
| |
---
| | Milestones invite us to look back with gratitude and forward with purpose — and right now, two extraordinary ones are colliding. As America prepares to celebrate 250 years of freedom, the Moms for America Podcast is marking a milestone of its own: 250 episodes dedicated to strengthening families, encouraging moms, and preserving the values that make our nation worth fighting for. Over the years, these conversations have explored the issues that matter most to families — faith, education, parental rights, American history, culture, and the sacred responsibility of raising the next generation. With nearly 7 million listeners so far in 2026, this special milestone reflection digs into five powerful themes that connect America's 250-year story with the heart of Moms for America: strong families, unshakeable faith, hard-won liberty, the courage of mothers who have always been on the front lines of freedom, and the torch we are called to pass to our children. When Benjamin Franklin walked out of the Constitutional Convention in 1787, a woman reportedly asked him, "Well, Doctor, what have we got — a republic or a monarchy?" He answered: "A republic, if you can keep it." Keeping it has always been the work of mothers — and this is their story. Don't miss it. Debbie Kraulidis sits down with Lara Trump — wife, mother, television host, political strategist, and member of one of the most recognized families in America — for | | Can 't see this message? | | | | | | | June 9, 2026 Newsletter | | Mom Life, Media, and America's Future | | | | For our milestone 250th episode, we could not have asked for a more perfect guest. Debbie Kraulidis sits down with Lara Trump — wife, mother, television host, political strategist, and member of one of the most recognized families in America — for a conversation as honest as it is inspiring. Lara opens up about meeting Eric Trump, raising children in the public eye, building a career without losing yourself, and navigating today's turbulent culture with grace, faith, and unshakeable purpose. This is not a polished talking-points interview. This is a real conversation between two women who love their families and love this country — and it shows. From the weight of public life to the quiet strength of motherhood, Lara shares the kind of personal insights you rarely hear. She talks about resilience, about raising kids when the stakes have never felt higher, and about why — at this moment in history — now is the time to celebrate this great nation like never before. 250 episodes. 250 years. One conversation you do not want to miss. Watch or listen now on , , , or — and help us celebrate this extraordinary milestone. | | | | | | Honoring 250 Episodes While Celebrating 250 Years of Freedom | | | | Milestones invite us to look back with gratitude and forward with purpose — and right now, two extraordinary ones are colliding. As America prepares to celebrate 250 years of freedom, the Moms for America Podcast is marking a milestone of its own: 250 episodes dedicated to strengthening families, encouraging moms, and preserving the values that make our nation worth fighting for. Over the years, these conversations have explored the issues that matter most to families — faith, education, parental rights, American history, culture, and the sacred responsibility of raising the next generation. With nearly 7 million listeners so far in 2026, this special milestone reflection digs into five powerful themes that connect America's 250-year story with the heart of Moms for America: strong families, unshakeable faith, hard-won liberty, the courage of mothers who have always been on the front lines of freedom, and the torch we are called to pass to our children. When Benjamin Franklin walked out of the Constitutional Convention in 1787, a woman reportedly asked him, "Well, Doctor, what have we got — a republic or a monarchy?" He answered: "A republic, if you can keep it." Keeping it has always been the work of mothers — and this is their story. Jay Feely

| | Dear Colleagues,
I’m delighted to launch my book,****[_**Courage Can Save US**_](https://us.list-manage.com/1Cy_wXsA3_j?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=ab78ed6ae5afc94e373df84430189363), today.**** Writing this book over the past three years has been one of the most meaningful projects of my life, and I could not have done it without the support of many friends, far and wide, and the trust and confidence of the ten Americans in the arena who are profiled across party lines and strive toward the Stoic ideal of servant-leadership.
The book reinforces****[**With Honor’s**](https://us.list-manage.com/gjiX4RgIXN7?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=ab78ed6ae5afc94e373df84430189363) mission: supporting principled veteran leadership in public office and encouraging service with integrity, civility, and courage. All author proceeds from sales go to With Honor.
Thanks to _Face the Nation_ for breaking the news this weekend. The full episode is linked below. We launch with an event at 92NY in NYC this evening. [Please register at this link](https://us.list-manage.com/5G3fMUyXK1x?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=ab78ed6ae5afc94e373df84430189363) if you or a friend are in the city tonight (between NBA Finals games!) and would like to join.

Together, we can encourage more Americans to serve first, cross our divides, and choose courage.
Thank you,

Peter, the moment
we've been bracing for is here.

AIPAC is launching ads to prop up our opponent and take us down — $2
million dollars’ worth of them.

This is a make-or-break moment for us,
Peter. [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260609-1-ak.6KQaLS&amount=10&refcode=em20260609-2336&t=1004&akid=2337%2E251025%2E0_qHHT ]Before you do anything
else, donate $10 to help us respond ASAP.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260609-1-ak.6KQaLS&amount=10&refcode=em20260609-2336&t=1023&akid=2337%2E251025%2E0_qHHT ]Donate $10 ››

I wish I could tell you I'm surprised. I'm not. We knew this was coming
the moment we said out loud that U.S. tax dollars should not fund a
genocide overseas.

Once the polls showed our campaign had built a strong, consistent lead,
AIPAC had their signal to throw the whole kitchen sink at us — and here it
is.

We've worked too hard, for too long, to let an outside group with
unlimited MAGA billionaire money dominate the airwaves in the final
stretch.

AIPAC didn't launch these ads randomly. Absentee ballots start going out
later this month. They want the final impression before Michiganders vote.

We can't let them have the last word,
Peter. I'm counting on this
grassroots team to make sure voters hear from us, not AIPAC.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260609-1-ak.6KQaLS&amount=10&refcode=em20260609-2336&t=1024&akid=2337%2E251025%2E0_qHHT ]Please, don’t wait: chip in $10 to help us run ads of
our own, organize across Michigan, and overcome AIPAC’s massive ad
campaign.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260609-1-ak.6KQaLS&amount=10&refcode=em20260609-2336&t=1043&akid=2337%2E251025%2E0_qHHT ]Donate $10 ››

I didn't get into this race to bow to the machine. I got in because the
system is rigged, healthcare is out of reach, and too many working people
have been left behind by politicians who answer to groups like AIPAC
instead of to them.

Every dollar you give is proof that a people-powered campaign can outlast
one backed by outside money. That's how we win and start changing what
politics in this country looks like.

In solidarity,

Abdul
