** Join Our June Autism Support Group
------------------------------------------------------------

We invite you to join us for our next Autism Support Group on Wednesday, June 17th at 5:00 PM PST on Zoom.

Whether you are a parent, caregiver, family member, self-advocate, or professional, our support group provides a welcoming and compassionate space to connect with others who understand the autism journey. Together, we share experiences, discuss challenges, celebrate successes, and learn from one another in a supportive community environment.

This monthly gathering offers an opportunity to hear personal stories, exchange practical resources, gain valuable insights, and build meaningful connections with families navigating autism and related neurological conditions. No matter where you are on your journey, you are not alone.

Join us for an evening of encouragement, education, and community as we come together to support one another.

Register using the link below to receive your Zoom access information.

We look forward to seeing you there!
REGISTER HERE (https://us06web.zoom.us/meeting/register/tKMTtxOXTt-ALHIpkJpn7Q?mc_cid=d0fce28963&mc_eid=UNIQID#/registration)

June Monthly Webinar with Dr. Kurt Woeller

Join us on Saturday, June 27th at 9:00 AM PST / 12:00 PM EST for an informative webinar featuring Dr. Kurt Woeller titled:

Methylcobalamin (Methyl-B12) Therapy: Remembering an Innovative Autism Intervention

Methylcobalamin (Methyl-B12) therapy has been one of the most widely discussed biomedical interventions in autism care over the past two decades. In this presentation, Dr. Woeller will review the history of Methyl-B12 therapy, the science behind its use, its role in supporting methylation and neurological function, and why it continues to be an important topic for families and practitioners working with individuals on the autism spectrum.

Attendees will learn about:
• The history and development of Methyl-B12 therapy in autism
• The relationship between methylation, detoxification, and neurological health
• Clinical observations and outcomes associated with Methyl-B12 treatment
• Practical considerations for parents and healthcare practitioners
• The ongoing relevance of this innovative intervention in autism care

Kurt N. Woeller, DO, FMAPS, is a Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine, integrative and functional medicine physician, and biomedical autism treatment specialist who has been in clinical practice for over three decades. He currently serves as the Chief Medical Officer for Mosaic Diagnostics and is recognized internationally for his work educating families and healthcare professionals on autism, neurodevelopmental disorders, and integrative medical approaches.

Whether you are a parent, caregiver, practitioner, or advocate, this webinar offers a valuable opportunity to learn from one of the field's most experienced clinicians.

Register using the link below to reserve your spot.
REGISTER HERE (https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_FdkMwMeUQSyr3GFzDQLx1Q?mc_cid=d0fce28963&mc_eid=UNIQID#/registration)

** Summer Movie Fundraiser to Support Autism Health
------------------------------------------------------------

Looking for a fun way to support Autism Health this summer? We are excited to partner with GroupRaise and Regal Cinemas for a special fundraising campaign that allows you to enjoy a night at the movies while supporting a great cause.

For just $30 per order, you'll receive a Regal Movie Ticket Bundle that includes two Standard 2D Movie Tickets, redeemable at any Regal theater location nationwide. Best of all, 20% of every purchase will be donated to Autism Health Inc. to help support our educational programs, support groups, webinars, scholarships, and research initiatives.

Did you know that many Regal Cinemas locations also offer Sensory Friendly Screenings? These special screenings are designed to create a more comfortable movie-going experience for individuals with autism and sensory sensitivities, making this fundraiser even more meaningful for our community.

Whether you're planning a family outing, date night, or looking for a unique gift, your purchase helps advance our mission of serving individuals and families impacted by autism and related neurological conditions.

Campaign Ends: Monday, August 17, 2026

Thank you for supporting Autism Health Inc. Every ticket bundle purchased helps us continue making a difference in the lives of families around the world.
BUY TICKETS HERE (https://www.groupraise.com/offer-campaigns/78957-autism-health-inc-regal-fundraising-campaigns?mc_cid=d0fce28963&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** AHS Recordings Now Available Online
------------------------------------------------------------

Missed the Autism Health Summit or want to revisit your favorite presentations? We are excited to announce that the full 3-day recordings from the Autism Health Summit are now available for purchase online.

This year’s Summit featured an extraordinary lineup of physicians, researchers, advocates, and thought leaders discussing emerging science, integrative approaches, environmental factors, clinical insights, and practical strategies for individuals impacted by autism and neurological conditions. Now, you can access these powerful presentations from the comfort of your home and learn at your own pace.

We are offering two recording options:
• General Recordings for parents, caregivers, and community members
• Professional Track Recordings for medical professionals seeking to earn 10.5 CME credits

Whether you attended the conference in person or could not join us in San Diego, this is an incredible opportunity to gain access to valuable education and expert insight from the Autism Health Summit.
REGISTER HERE (https://ahsconference.com/pricing-table/?mc_cid=d0fce28963&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Save the Date: Cocktails for A Cause
https://ahsconference.com/?mc_cid=d0fce28963&mc_eid=UNIQID

We are excited to invite you to our upcoming Cocktails for A Cause fundraiser benefiting Autism Health Inc. on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM at The Park Club in Costa Mesa, CA.

Sponsored by Cellular Performance Institute, this special evening will bring together supporters, families, professionals, and community leaders for a night of connection, purpose, and giving back. Guests will enjoy cocktails, networking, inspiring presentations from featured speakers (to be announced), and both a live auction and silent auction filled with exciting items and experiences.

Tickets are $85 per person, and proceeds from the evening will help support Autism Health Inc.’s ongoing mission to provide education, resources, support programs, and outreach for families impacted by autism and neurological conditions.

We hope you will join us for this meaningful evening as we come together to make a difference in the lives of so many families.
BUY TICKETS HERE (https://givebutter.com/cocktails-4-a-cause?gbtid=6973b353-2ebb-4a2b-be6f-b0a7a0f1fab1&mc_cid=d0fce28963&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Please Vote for the 2026 Author of the Year

We are honored to share that Tracy Slepcevic, Co-Founder and President of Autism Health Inc., has been nominated for the 2026 Author of the Year award through the International Impact Book Awards.

Tracy’s bestselling book, Warrior Mom: A Mother's Journey in Healing Her Son with Autism, has inspired and empowered families around the world through her heartfelt story of perseverance, faith, and determination as a mother navigating the autism journey. More than just a memoir, Warrior Mom has become a trusted guidebook for parents seeking hope, practical insight, and encouragement while advocating for their children.

The book has received praise from many respected voices, including the endorsement from Robert F. Kennedy Jr., who described Warrior Mom as:
“An inspiring testimony to the miraculous power of maternal love.”

We would deeply appreciate your support in helping recognize Tracy’s impact and dedication to the autism community. Voting closes on August 31, 2026, and every vote makes a difference.

Learn more about Warrior Mom at: www.WarriorMom.com (https://track.pstmrk.it/3/www.warriormom.com%2F/b43o/L_3FAQ/AQ/1e8dc077-67d4-4f00-9a86-56cc56326a8e/6/BVXljYYuHI?mc_cid=d0fce28963&mc_eid=UNIQID)
VOTE HERE (https://apply.internationalimpactbookawards.com/public-voting-form?mc_cid=d0fce28963&mc_eid=UNIQID)

About Autism Health Inc.
Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders.
DONATE HERE (https://autismhealth.com/donations/?mc_cid=d0fce28963&mc_eid=UNIQID)
Autism Health Inc. depends on generous donations from our community. Large or small, every donation gets us closer to achieving our goals. We are grateful for your assistance! For more information about Autism Health, visit www.AutismHealth.com

One mission for life

| | | | | | Peter, every once in a while, I can’t help but look back at where I came from.
I’ve spent years serving the American people, from the cockpit of a helicopter to the halls of Congress.
When I close my eyes, I can still hear the hum of the engines preparing for takeoff from the deck of a carrier.
In those times, I wasn’t thinking of politics or polls... I was thinking about my crew, the mission, and my country.
[Now, the years have passed. The uniforms have changed, but the mission remains the same:](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)
---
| [PUT AMERICANS FIRST!](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.-JNgE3GTdTg)
---
That’s why I ran for office back in 2022, and that’s why I’m officially back in the fight today.
I flipped this seat from BLUE to RED, something D.C. experts said “could never be done.”
The Left poured millions of dollars into attack ads, hoping my message of common-sense leadership would be drowned out by their screaming.
It didn’t work the first time... but they seem to think it will work this time.
Because the minute I launched my campaign for re-election, they marked my race as a “must-win” and have already started to let their money do the talking.
But that's ok because you and I both know, you can’t buy your way in Virginia... you have to EARN it!
And, Peter, I’ve spent all my time in office working to earn your trust by championing policies that put AMERICANS FIRST!
[So, if you have a second and want to show the Democrats that they don't stand a chance in this fight, please chip in anything you can spare now to support my re-election campaign today:](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.-wCw)
---
| [DEFEND THIS SEAT!](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.-lrQ)
---
| [SUPPORT MY CAMPAIGN](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)
---
We already proved we can win the “nail-biters.” Now, let’s show them that once this seat is RED, it stays RED.
With grit and gratitude,
Jen Kiggans

Together we will get our country back on the right track and secure America’s success!

He was 17 years old when a gunman walked into Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida, with an AR-15 and took the lives of 17 students and educators, injuring 17 others.
No one should have to live through that kind of horror. And we should never have to depend on people surviving tragedy before our country decides to change.
This is our “documentary moment”. A sliver of time where every action we take has the power to shape what comes next. Saving each other depends on people willing to speak plainly, challenge the status quo, and imagine something better together.
So that’s exactly what we’re doing.

clean_body: | Hi there, it’s Jane Fonda here with a special invitation for our most engaged supporters: On Tuesday, July 14th, I’m teaming up with activist and founder of Leaders We Deserve, David Hogg, for a virtual conversation about the future of our country, why primaries matter, and what it will take to elect leaders brave enough to meet this moment. = = | = David’s story is one that no person should ever have to experience. He was 17 years old when a gunman walked into Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida, with an AR-15 and took the lives of 17 students and educators, injuring 17 others. No one should have to live through that kind of horror. And we should never have to depend on people surviving tragedy before our country decides to change. This is our “documentary moment”. A sliver of time where every action we take has the power to shape what comes next. Saving each other depends on people willing to speak plainly, challenge the status quo, and imagine something better together. body:
Rep. David Valadao — AKA The Congressman Who Stole Health Care.
#
Peter,
In California’s Central Valley, GOP Representative David Valadao has earned the reputation of being _“The Congressman who stole health care.”_
Now, his seat is up for grabs in this November, and this is one of the districts that could decide control of the House this fall.
Latino voters will be a deciding factor in the outcome of this race. That’s why California’s 22nd Congressional District is on our list of top target races — but we need your help to defeat Valado and flip CA-22.
**[Will you rush a $3 donation to Voto Latino right now to power our mobilization and voter registration efforts ahead of November?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260609-1-ak.BHVaqq&amount=3&refcode=em20260609-232&t=1&akid=232%2E1366028%2EfCvRIg)**
**David Valadao is one of the most vulnerable Republicans in the battle for the House** , and his seat is considered a toss-up by multiple political analysts.
**This district has a Latino population of 73%** , and it is exactly the kind of place where a strong voter registration push and turnout can change the outcome in November.
This seat is flippable because:
* Valadao has voted with Trump 100% of the time, including his budget bill, which ripped health care away from over 65,000 people in his district

* He supports efforts that put Medi-Cal coverage at risk. Medi-Cal is a state Medicaid program that provides health care coverage to low-income Americans and helps give them access to doctors, prescriptions, and hospital care

* He’s already lost his seat before. The last time he voted to endanger health care, he lost supporters. He is continuing to go against the interests and health of his constituents.

**The only way we beat politicians like this is by making sure Latino voters in California are registered, informed, and turn out.**
[**Peter, will you make a donation of $3 or any amount now to help us flip this crucial seat and take back the House this November?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260609-1-ak.BHVaqq&amount=3&refcode=em20260609-232&t=2&akid=232%2E1366028%2EfCvRIg)

Thank you,
Voto Latino

subject: Why not us?

body:
We're going to make Ohio the best place to live, work, and raise a family.

| [](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDYwOV9RUC0wTi4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MjEyNDgtMzYyMyZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA2MDlfUVAtME4uMTEwMTE3X3QxOTIxMjQ4LTM2MjMifQ/l76b7znazZbrUKRn6p3-ug)

In 2020, when I watched Florida become the first state to reopen its economy, I asked the question:
[Why not us?](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDYwOV9RUC0wTi4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MjEyNDgtMzYyMyZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA2MDlfUVAtME4uMTEwMTE3X3QxOTIxMjQ4LTM2MjMifQ/wHPsV_0d_PuX-VhNVtUpcw)
In 2021, when I watched Tennessee become a zero income tax state, I asked the question:
[Why not us?](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDYwOV9RUC0wTi4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MjEyNDgtMzYyMyZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA2MDlfUVAtME4uMTEwMTE3X3QxOTIxMjQ4LTM2MjMifQ/rEqMQOzPx-5iZmwSkT6Srg)
In 2022, when states like Arizona and Iowa adopted universal school choice, I asked the question:
[Why not us?](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDYwOV9RUC0wTi4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MjEyNDgtMzYyMyZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA2MDlfUVAtME4uMTEwMTE3X3QxOTIxMjQ4LTM2MjMifQ/PaBHxy2MupwuLCtQhP7l9Q)
In 2024, when the CEO of a company I founded in Columbus, Ohio told me that he needed to move the business that I BUILT IN OHIO to Texas, I asked him the question:
[Why not us?](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDYwOV9RUC0wTi4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MjEyNDgtMzYyMyZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA2MDlfUVAtME4uMTEwMTE3X3QxOTIxMjQ4LTM2MjMifQ/Hz55rdg8hHb2xV_CsfunHw)
I'm tired of watching other states succeed while Ohio falls behind. I refuse to accept decline as destiny.
[That’s why I’m running for Governor of Ohio – to make sure that WILL be us.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDYwOV9RUC0wTi4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MjEyNDgtMzYyMyZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA2MDlfUVAtME4uMTEwMTE3X3QxOTIxMjQ4LTM2MjMifQ/Zpb6QcJDITgJefV-r5ishw)
We're going to make Ohio the best place to live, work, and raise a family. And when we get this right in just ONE STATE, Ohio becomes the model, and America follows.
[Will you read my blueprint for Ohio and chip in a few bucks to help me make it happen?](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDYwOV9RUC0wTi4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MjEyNDgtMzYyMyZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA2MDlfUVAtME4uMTEwMTE3X3QxOTIxMjQ4LTM2MjMifQ/FYaMSzz9IS753hO-X05URQ)

I'm a pediatrician. I’m pissed. I’m scared. And I need your help to defeat Lindsey Graham in the U.S. Senate.
I’m not the “monsters-under-the-bed” kind of scared. I’m the “I’ve watched children suffer from preventable illness and injury while politicians do absolutely nothing” kind of scared.
I’ve treated kids who’ve been shot. Kids whose families struggle to afford their medications.
Kids who live with mold that causes asthma attacks, miss school for climate disasters, and watch politicians use them as political pawns.
And now? Trump is causing chaos and Lindsey Graham is right by his side.
And Medicaid — the program that keeps half our pediatric patients insured, healthy, and...alive — is on the chopping block to pay for tax breaks for billionaires.
So yeah, I never planned to run for Senate.

Team, it’s Mark.
Late last year, Donald Trump came after me. He called for my arrest and hanging. Over the following weeks and months, the Departments of Justice and Defense followed his lead. They tried to court-martial me, indict me, reduce my rank and pension, and silence two million veterans alongside me — and so far they’ve failed.
All for saying something the President didn’t like, I had to face down the full weight of the Executive Branch.
Now, I remember last year pretty clearly. I remember that pardoning the people who committed crimes on January 6th was one of the first things Donald Trump did as president. Favors for the people who stormed our Capitol, assaulted cops, and tried to overturn an election in his name.
Silencing veterans, but pardoning criminals. That’s what justice looks like under Trump.
Over the last several weeks, we’ve seen Trump and his allies try to create a $1.8 billion slush fund for those criminals. Both Republicans and Democrats pushed back on that, and eventually they backed down. But the word of this President, his White House, and his Department of Justice are next to worthless.
The fund might be done for now, but we need to make sure it’s gone for good. That means we can’t let up — not yet.

name: Lindsey Graham
subject: The American Dream isn't just a slogan.
body:
I learned some tough lessons early on. |
---

I want to share something from the heart with you, Fellow American.

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=26029c20894c4db7a6b04001c3fe049f&_e=ZgfDfGAWEYg3IyeLzpoBNTQu03khcSpWcjgWkxBmzflw9f0mcUbtQt8imnEIRCVTeFh1uw_r7QDxS2u75mxUWPKCy7_tftkQtFJiXPmocRP3a11uIiOWBLffSK-VsxpVtjOYMTEwmilKG1hMvacby1Q5KtyaIClo2eqYkggnNu16bNzMXUBfYrCLAVLtlo-IvEMIScJkstqydpj1roZu9Gqi6SXxuj16I9ppifDK1508gN8feZZPTNXWXgb8uDBbX0jJfmPX7j6hS-QRIeh7hljcCACX26EpZ3X0gqIo4x-2BoBd7fW-j6_mmfPWSZwJQXdT906rngSFFoGH0_CvdLm3i0FS38w51Dx0HQdILAXDa2C7PSu9ufyGNqaEyx0l6jHHRInwJGmDYDT-H-_5K0h2ob_W8-AD3ssUjXRILO23HHQf1_PYCQfvAj-5ajrPzPSEMMZTSZ5lVFv2OkGiG1zekmI6kSJx1Em0r4wm6j5JSFc__GnC2MV2SJavA6BbN98ikLep4Pi8DnUSxAE9N87AOfno50FccW5KfFOs_SV4I0DlQhjLjFyx-o6VT60u-XpCV_bgCj9pwRhKrtmCQ-HkptcaUdBc-YTU9ONlLzSapOd0SkR4fjXLtnslXP2rTbe8lIAiw8DBeZAsWtrZoriOmQNE2i65aWHvZDRY-RpVifhISh88Mi7LfJU93QkKf06AKPcQ3HbZmEb8IGwwxYVLxksiw-6vBDHYZf0SD90rI4QtkHWTQdZKh60E8yxndWZFA_ihpWffuHGp11ojBg%3D%3D)
**_My story._**
It isn't one of glitz and glamour - it's about hard work, loss, and fighting for what's right. I'm reaching out to tell you why I'm in this fight for our future, and why I need you with me.

Neither of my parents finished high school. But they were hardworking and determined that their children would surpass their achievements.

Most of my growing up happened on the main street of a small textile mill town. My parents had a business establishment - a combination beer joint, restaurant, liquor store, and pool hall - known as the Sanitary Cafe right on Main Street in Central, SC. We all lived in the back of the bar where we worked late into the evening, especially my mom, before heading off to bed in the backroom.

I had no silver spoon in my mouth but I never felt I was missing out on something because I didn't live in a house like my friends did. I had a great life, and it was a great way to grow up.

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=26029c20894c4db7a6b04001c3fe049f&_e=ZgfDfGAWEYg3IyeLzpoBNTQu03khcSpWcjgWkxBmzflw9f0mcUbtQt8imnEIRCVTeFh1uw_r7QDxS2u75mxUWPKCy7_tftkQtFJiXPmocRP3a11uIiOWBLffSK-VsxpVtjOYMTEwmilKG1hMvacby1Q5KtyaIClo2eqYkggnNu16bNzMXUBfYrCLAVLtlo-IvEMIScJkstqydpj1roZu9Gqi6SXxuj16I9ppifDK1508gN8feZZPTNXWXgb8uDBbX0jJfmPX7j6hS-QRIeh7hnpvZkLEyJTYElFg7Pe-hLQXbuqSiKEU_cNsakzjnQsJ8jbsMRFLSVfDxpvGS411WZY16obp_ZGNCi1ctvokvn4ng0PBvafqM1w8PIE_8-U6QY2pUCTHadO7Lcnw0VPq9D894OIWYhi_6CbFgdxlauZMDsisnxDb_HvOcSKki89EblTgzkEPr3LoLB9E-JvqbW9NGESOyyozTxbr_SKUvwpZ8ZDhfVKICZdn5QqVDsmFGR1EfAYCKkV-lJPshF9vA9rT4dPs5pMSuEmAwfYxa3rDXA7l4B5KIZmejouWMFv80A1VxUgWkIS9qiCs_1288k0siimNlCTDELi2dTnbzhqFLqLT4nirAL3rh4Va5hb56nPjLAIkr_m-TVHqCWHjnvisUon0GH7IkAil8EdTZuVsvo4fr1EfEa8X3imtwrbRLl7EeyeKGyKfp7hVxqfa-UY6LYpQn5Ym507tACBMc_tVVaRnK_GSRkDEKYBHCNTCk85r7gO8CQbIASl15pDrQQ%3D%3D)
I was the first in my family to attend college, but then life hit me hard. While I was in school, I lost my mom and dad within two years of each other. And just like that, I stepped up to help raise my 13-year-old sister, Darline, while coming back home on the weekends to help at our family business.

**Fellow American, I learned some tough lessons early on.**

After law school, I joined the U.S. Air Force as a Judge Advocate General, serving as a military prosecutor and defense attorney. Even after the people of South Carolina sent me to the United States Senate, I continued my service in the Air Force Reserves. I performed several short deployments in war zones like Afghanistan and Iraq, standing shoulder to shoulder with our brave men and women in uniform.

My story isn't all that different from yours or most people across this great country. I didn't have anything handed to me. I worked hard, grew up quickly, and took on big responsibilities.

**But what shaped me most was listening to the hard -working South Carolinians who'd come by our family business, sharing their hopes and struggles, or hearing the perspectives of my brave colleagues in the military.** _Whether I agreed with them or not, those conversations built my understanding of what Americans need and deserve._

Now, Fellow American, we all know our nation's in a tough spot - we're divided, but there are some things we should agree on, plain and simple.
> **🇺🇸 We need a country where you can raise your family without fear, where the streets are safe.**
>
> **🇺🇸 We need a country where the American Dream isn't just a slogan.**
>
> _It's alive, and every hard -working American has a real shot at it, no matter where they start._

clean_body: I learned some tough lessons early on. | I want to share something from the heart with you, Fellow American. My story. It isn't one of glitz and glamour - it's about hard work, loss, and fighting for what's right. I'm reaching out to tell you why I'm in this fight for our future, and why I need you with me. Neither of my parents finished high school. But they were hardworking and determined that their children would surpass their achievements. Most of my growing up happened on the main street of a small textile mill town. My parents had a business establishment - a combination beer joint, restaurant, liquor store, and pool hall - known as the Sanitary Cafe right on Main Street in Central, SC. We all lived in the back of the bar where we worked late into the evening, especially my mom, before heading off to bed in the backroom. I had no silver spoon in my mouth but I never felt I was missing out on something because I didn't live in a house like my friends did. I had a great life, and it was a great way to grow up. I was the first in my family to attend college, but then life hit me hard. While I was in school, I lost my mom and dad within two years of each other. And just like that, I stepped up to help raise my 13-year-old sister, Darline, while coming back home on the weekends to help at our family business. Fellow American, I learned some tough lessons early on. After law school, I joined the U.S. Air Force as a Judge Advocate General, serving as a military prosecutor and defense attorney. Even after the people of South Carolina sent me to the United States Senate, I continued my service in the Air Force Reserves. I performed several short deployments in war zones like Afghanistan and Iraq, standing shoulder to shoulder with our brave men and women in uniform. My story isn't all that different from yours or most people across this great country. I didn't have anything handed to me. I worked hard, grew up quickly, and took on big responsibilities. But what shaped me most was listening to the hard -working South Carolinians who'd come by our family business, sharing their hopes and struggles, or hearing the perspectives of my brave colleagues in the military. Whether I agreed with them or not, those conversations built my understanding of what Americans need and deserve. Now, Fellow American, we all know our nation's in a tough spot - we're divided, but there are some things we should agree on, plain and simple. 🇺🇸 We need a country where you can raise your family without fear, where the streets are safe. 🇺🇸 We need a country where the American Dream isn't just a slogan. It's alive, and every hard -working American has a real shot at it, no matter where they start. Sadly, there are folks in Washington, across the aisle, who don't see it that way. They're fine with open borders, allowing violent crime spill into our neighborhoods. They're okay with slapping higher taxes on hard-working folks like you, piling more burdens on your family. That isn't right, and I won't stand for it. So I'm coming to you with a simple ask, Fellow American. If you've got a few dollars to spare, Fellow American, I know we can build a country that keeps our communities safe, rewards hard work, and gives every American a chance to chase their dreams - just like I did. Thank you for taking a minute to hear my story. I'm grateful for you. Sincerely, Lindsey Graham In the United States Senate, South Carolina's Lindsey Graham has earned a reputation as a conservative, a problem-solver, and a leader who gets things done. He is a great friend to our men and women serving in uniform, a respected voice on national security matters, a leading advocate for cutting the out-of-control spending in Washington, and a champion for confirming conservative judges. We want to make sure you're a proud member of Team Graham, and we don't want to bother you. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133015282/626445067/-1721553747?refcode=BLU_EM_AFMC_2026-06-09_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjlmZDdkOS0zYjY0LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BUC8Hp2hnLW5EJnXReViB_vP0Vm7SYMLgTrbFeNViEc=)

| Peter,

Today marks exactly two weeks until Election Day, and I've spent a lot of time reflecting.

And as I think about this final stretch, I keep coming back to one simple question: **Why am I doing this?** The answer is easy. Because I love Montgomery County. I love that people come here to build a life. To raise a family. To start a business. To find opportunity. To put down roots and become part of a community. For so many people, Montgomery County isn't just where they live. _**It's home. It's the only place my wife, Demi, and I have ever called home.**_

But increasingly, too many families are wondering whether they can afford to stay. Rising housing costs. Higher taxes. Increasing costs for just about everything. People who have spent years building their lives here are feeling squeezed. _**I don't think that's right.**_

And now that I'm a parent, this feels even more personal. I want our daughter to grow up in a Montgomery County where families can thrive. A place where opportunity is within reach. A place where people aren't forced out by rising costs and short-sighted decisions.

name: Mallory McMorrow
subject: Some numbers to know
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McMorrow for Michigan
body:
Here’s exactly what we’re up against
# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=4926%2E898137%2EnEwCIa)
Here are some numbers you need to know:
**$45 million.** That’s how much a leading GOP super PAC plans to spend here in Michigan to put Mike Rogers in the Senate.
**$12.8 million.** That’s how much super PACs have spent for our primary opponent to try to buy this seat.
**$0.** That’s how much corporate PAC money I’ve taken. Not a single cent. Because I only answer to the people of Michigan, not special interests.
**$21.59.** That’s our average contribution, and it’s how we win.
On the other side, millions of dollars are flowing in from corporations and super PACs trying to control the outcome. On our side, real people are sending what they can because they care about the future of Michigan.
We don't need to match them dollar-for-dollar, but we do need enough to make sure our message gets out with just weeks until ballots hit mailboxes.
**[Will you donate $10 today to help us keep our momentum going all the way to November?](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/4?c0=mam-em-june2026.Nocb4p&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260609_PM1_V1_S1&amount=10&t=2&akid=4926%2E898137%2EnEwCIa)**

| This is what the beginning of election subversion looks like.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9854%2E5257348%2EGMEvvJ)
Derek, We're barely a week out from California's primary election, and Republicans are already lying and spreading conspiracy theories about it. The President recently said this: [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q22026_abs_em.dQeZoR&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20260609_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=9854%2E5257348%2EGMEvvJ) And the pathetic Speaker of the House added his own falsehoods, piling on to what the President said: [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q22026_abs_em.dQeZoR&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20260609_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=9854%2E5257348%2EGMEvvJ) These conspiracy theories have no basis in fact. None. Our elections are administered by trained professionals following rigorous, transparent processes. And yes, we all wish the counting was faster. But that's not the point. The point is to sow doubt. To delegitimize results before they're even final. To build the predicate for challenging outcomes they don't like. _Both in this election, and future ones._ I've seen this playbook before. I was in the Capitol on January 6th when the lies about our elections turned into an insurrection. I know what's coming next. The lies about California are just the dry run for a systematic campaign to undermine our elections. **And this time, they have the full weight of the federal government behind them. The Justice Department. Billions of dollars. Power they didn’t have in 2020.** [**That's why your support right now has never been more important. It's not enough to win, we need to make sure people are educated and we have the resources to fight back AFTER the election.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q22026_abs_em.dQeZoR&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20260609_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=9854%2E5257348%2EGMEvvJ) [ ](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q22026_abs_em.dQeZoR&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20260609_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=7&akid=9854%2E5257348%2EGMEvvJ) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [EXPRESS DONATE $10](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2142?c0=q22026_abs_em.nSz-K7&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20260609_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=8&akid=9854%2E5257348%2EGMEvvJ)

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: I feel more like squaring up
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
I'm not going to give them my fear.
#
This administration is much more prepared and planned this time around, in terms of the kinds of chaos that they're trying to unleash.
More than legal programs, more than policy, **they are trying to invoke _fear_**.
That is how authoritarianism works. These are the tools to get us to sacrifice and surrender our civil liberties, more than they take them.
Trump pardoned virtually all the January 6th insurrectionists, including specifically people who were arrested with threats against my life.
**I'm not going to give them my fear**. I feel more like squaring up than anything else.
When I was running in 2018, people would say, “Why should we vote for a waitress instead of this 20-year incumbent?” — understandably, right? I didn't have experience. They did. And I often talked about the story of _The Wizard of Oz_.
This was my mom's favorite movie. I know it's in the zeitgeist now because _Wicked_ is out, but genuinely: all of these big, scary things, it reminds me of the end of _The Wizard of Oz_ , where you yank back the curtain — and _it's a little guy_.
**It's a small, scared, incompetent little man**.
I think we need to remain focused. Yes, they are capable of immense amounts of damage.
It can be scary. It's not something we ignore. It's not something we check out from.
But we register it. We say, “OK.” **Then we figure out what our options are and we do the best we can, day by day**.
They're relying on us giving up. **Hell no**.
We’re going to keep standing with trans people.
We’re going to keep standing with the LGBT community.
We’re going to keep standing for the working class.
We’re going to keep fighting for a better minimum wage.
We’re going to keep fighting to guarantee healthcare.
[Help us continue the fight with a grassroots contribution today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260609.BrCbsj&refcode=em20260609-11648-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=11648%2E2526796%2Ev3mSNb)

In solidarity,
Alexandria

Peter, Today matters. And what comes next matters even more. All across Maine, people are working hard, paying their bills, doing their best and still feeling like they’re falling behind. That’s why I’m in this race. I’m not running to add to the noise. I’m running to offer something different: steady, independent leadership focused on what Maine families are dealing with every single day. **What I’m working for:**
* **Making Life Affordable****
**So families can keep up with the cost of groceries, housing, energy, and child care.

* **Growing Maine’s Economy****
**So more people can find opportunity here, build a future here, and keep their families in Maine.

* **Restoring Trust in Government****
**So people know their governor is working for them, not party bosses, insiders, or political games.

That’s the difference in this campaign. I’m focused on real life, not rhetoric.
On solutions, not partisan fights.
On helping Maine families get a fair shot, not asking them to settle for less. **[If you believe in that kind of leadership, will you chip in today?](https://www.supportrickbennett.com/donate?e=939e09e235be96b0bea768d960703804&utm_source=bennettforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=primary_day_ask&n=1)** Your donation will help us reach more voters, grow this campaign, and show that Mainers are ready for a governor who puts people first. And yet, working families across the Central Valley proved that they are ready for a new type of leadership in Congress. **And we’re ready to prove it again in November.** The Republican incumbent, David Valadao, has already raised more than $4 million this cycle. Let's start with this simple fact: if we want to flip the House blue this November, it’s critical that we reelect our House Democratic incumbents here in Virginia.

That work starts with people like my friend, Congressman Bobby Scott.

Over the years working together in Congress, I've come to see firsthand the dedication and impact Bobby brings to Virginia's third district. We’ve worked together to expand broadband across the Commonwealth, bringing internet access to rural and low-income communities. We’ve advocated for Virginia’s coastal communities, bringing thousands of jobs through off-shore wind projects and port infrastructure. And we’ve collaborated closely to make sure our veterans and military families get the services and support they deserve.

**But I also want to tell you how hard Bobby actually works.**

I've done probably hundreds of town halls, tours, and meetings with Bobby. And in every single one, I’ve seen his commitment to his constituents. The truth is, the only thing that matters to him is listening – hearing exactly what Virginians need and what they want him fighting for in Washington. Then he goes and gets things done.

That may sound simple, but too many folks in Washington these days forget that good public service is about working for the people you represent, not partisan games or political stunts. We all know we have big challenges facing this country: a cost-of-living crisis, a health care access bottleneck, economic disruption brought on by AI. We need leaders in Washington who focus on solving problems – Bobby is one of those leaders.

[_**That's why I'm asking: will you split a $5 or $10 contribution to Bobby Scott and my campaign today? body:
Some of the wealthiest MAGA billionaires in the country are trying to buy this Senate seat.

| |
---|---|---
| | | Forwarded this email? [Subscribe here](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oYWxleWZvcm1pLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.mCgzNOxAdqzXXqh3wulbE0T03YqPQPVUte5l9fZ9I0g?) for more

# [Mike Rogers' MAGA billionaires are shopping for a Senate seat in Michigan](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=201210076&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAxMjEwMDc2LCJpYXQiOjE3ODEwMzkyNDAsImV4cCI6MTc4MzYzMTI0MCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.jYdcZJmKBoW39xq8kekGpvbyrB-8MasPXphysdnIe24)
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Jun 9
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..8UhS5IL-34yugIV8gP8vXWMOLGxBtgrwVvOtH0ZsgQQ?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/mike-rogers-maga-billionaires-are?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

**Some of the wealthiest MAGA billionaires in the country are trying to buy this Senate seat.**
Here's what's going on: A far-right super PAC aligned with the Koch network - one of the largest dark-money groups in this country - announced a massive Senate ad buy to back Republican candidates.
They are spending millions in a handful of battleground states, and **Michigan is at the top of their list.**
Basically, these ultrarich MAGA guys are shopping for Senate seats.
And they think if they spend enough money and drown out grassroots campaigns like ours, then they can buy themselves a shiny new senator. Mike Rogers, specifically.
The part that makes me furious is that the people writing these giant checks don't care about Michiganders. They've never worked in a Michigan plant, never sat in a Michigan classroom, never felt anything close to Michigan pride.
They don't know anything about us. And they definitely don't know the reality so many Michigan families are dealing with right now.
They've never stood at the grocery checkout and told the cashier to put things back because they couldn't afford the total.
They've never pulled into a gas station and only put in a couple of gallons because they don't get paid until Friday.
They've never had to tell their kid they can't play Little League or go to camp this summer because the fees are too expensive.
They've never canceled a doctor's appointment because they were nervous about the bill.
And they've never sat at a kitchen table at 11 p.m., staring at their bills with that gut-wrenching feeling of not knowing how to make it work this month.
Folks, I talk to so many Michiganders every day, and I'm sure you or someone you know has had that experience.
But I promise you these MAGA billionaires have never experienced any of that. They're too busy trying to decide whether to buy another private jet or a megayacht.
Tough choice.
And now they've got the gall to tell the people of Michigan what's best for us?
Excuse my bluntness, but these Koch guys can see themselves out.
But there's hope: They are targeting us because they know we can win.
**The Koch-aligned PAC is spending more in Michigan than almost anywhere else because the polls keep showing I can beat Mike Rogers in November. And they know if we win here, Democrats can flip the Senate.**
But if MAGA Republicans win here and keep control of the Senate, it will be more of the chaos we've already seen: the slush funds. The tax cuts for billionaires. The pardons for cronies. The war that's driving up gas prices. The rubber stamps for Donald Trump, over and over and over again.
They are not investing in Mike Rogers because they think he is some great public servant. They are investing in him because he is Trump's yes-man who will do what he's told. He's going to advance the MAGA agenda, no questions asked.
So here's the favor I'm asking: If you see the next attack ad on TV in Michigan - and you will, because they have paid for A LOT of them - I want you to remember the people behind that ad have probably never been to your town. I want you to remember that these MAGA billionaires are spending this money not because they care about working families but because they want to advance their right-wing ideas. They have no plan to make your life better or more affordable. They do not care about Michigan.
But I do. Deeply.
I am running for the U.S. Senate because I love Michigan and because I believe the people who live here - and ONLY the people who live here - should get to decide who represents them in the Senate.
That is what democracy looks like.
And in November, we're going to send the Koch-aligned PACs and every out-of-state MAGA billionaire who put Michigan on their shopping list a message they will not be able to ignore: Michigan belongs to Michiganders.
**[I'd be honored if you chipped in whatever you can to help.](https://substack.com/redirect/76e765a1-3004-4bab-b870-c9f0a16ec228?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Together, we are going to beat Mike Rogers and flip the Senate, and then I am going to fight like hell every single day for Michigan's working families.
You have my word.
That is the Michigan way.
More soon.
With grit,
Haley
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/76e765a1-3004-4bab-b870-c9f0a16ec228?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

body:
BREAKING: Tina Peters is coming to Freedom Fest!
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/satf3aa0e34)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s2n9ed745a6)**
| | Hi friends!
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s5uba0f55aa), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s1m88c411d1) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s5qf735c2a5).
We're excited to announce a major addition to the Freedom Fest lineup...
**🇺🇸 TINA PETERS IS COMING TO FREEDOM FEST.****[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s3uf6973101)**
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/sdsd218432e)
In what will be one of her first major public appearances since her release, Tina Peters will join us on the Friday Main Stage at RMV Freedom Fest on June 26 in Castle Rock.
As Mesa County Clerk, Tina became one of the most recognized figures in the election integrity movement. Her legal battles, imprisonment, and eventual release captured national attention and sparked debate across the country. And Rocky Mountain Voice has [covered every step](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s6p2bd577ba) of it.
_**Now, she'll share her story directly with Freedom Fest attendees.**_
Joining Tina on our **Friday Main Stage** are: ⭐ Lara Logan
⭐ Dr. Kevin Roberts
⭐ Mike Davis
⭐ Jeremy Dys
⭐ Seth Keshel
⭐ Kelsey Reinhardt
⭐ Patti Fox
⭐ Erin Lee
⭐ Mark Cook
⭐ Beverly Vance Aikins
⭐ Heidi Ganahl And many more...
With just 17 days until Freedom Fest, this lineup continues to grow into one of the most significant gatherings of conservative leaders, journalists, policy experts, and grassroots activists in Colorado.
**👉[RMVFreedomFest.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s6gd380e394)**
Interested in volunteering? Click here to fill out our **[Volunteer Interest Form](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/seha4553443)**!
We're currently looking for volunteers to help make Freedom Fest a success. Volunteers who commit to a single 4-hour shift will receive _**complimentary day passes for both days of the festival**_ (evening events not included), allowing you to experience Freedom Fest while helping create something truly special for Colorado. _**But spots are limited!**_
**[June 26-27 | Douglas County Fairgrounds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s8jb841d455)** 🎟️ **[RMVFreedomFest.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/sdrf0bbe205)**
**Only 17 days remain.** **We'll see you there.**
This is your Mountain Minute for Tuesday, June 9, 2026.
– Team RMV
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Property taxes up, TABOR refunds nearly gone: El Paso County data reveals the real cost of Colorado’s tax system](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s1h3fdef6a1)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/samebad3d7e)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s7j72b8383a)
The first-half property tax payment is due every year by the end of February. The number on the front has gone up again. Somewhere near the bottom, a small credit appears: “TABOR credit.”
El Paso County Assessor Mark Flutcher provided RMV with six years of certified tax data for two El Paso County properties: one in downtown Colorado Springs, one in Lorson Ranch, a newer subdivision south of the city.
The numbers show what has happened to Colorado homeowners. The property tax bill for the downtown home rose from $1,165.61 in 2022 to $1,472.82 in 2025. The Lorson Ranch bill went from $3,369.39 to $4,933.31 over the same period.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/sftccd90ba3)**
|
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s4p65a116bf)
**Be part of history at Freedom Festival 2026.** Celebrate America’s 250th and Colorado’s 150th with with 2000+ patriots: two unforgettable days of speakers, action, community, and FUN for the whole family at the Douglas County Fairgrounds. _America only turns 250 once. Colorado only turns 150 once._ Secure your tickets now and be part of it.
[GET YOUR TICKETS NOW!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s6p16670dc8)
|
---
**[Colorado calls its elections a model. Mark Cook says voters have lost oversight of them](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s0s675f3907)** BY RMV STAFF, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s6o3b46e54e)
* **Cook's concern isn't that a result was rigged — it's structural:** he argues election administration has drifted from county clerks to state agencies, private vendors, and coordinating bodies, until the people closest to voters have the least say — a frustration El Paso County Clerk Steve Schleiker reflected when he withdrew from the Colorado County Clerks Association over transparency concerns.
* **Cook says most clerks are good people "handcuffed" by state laws they have little power to change:** audits and paper ballots don't address the deeper problem, he argues — whether citizens can independently verify the process — and a February Rasmussen poll found 63% of likely voters share concerns about electronic voting system vulnerabilities.
* **Cook's near-term fix is a "parallel election" — citizens organizing their own counts and comparing results with official totals:** his long-term solution is returning control to local hands county by county, and he says he'd welcome a conversation with both Secretary of State Griswold and Gov. Polis — "the truth is the truth."

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/seh5542fff1)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/seua18643fa)
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[The reliability weapon: Humpty’s wall](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s7r8cda9f9f)** **BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | JUNE 8** _Most people think the lesson of Humpty Dumpty is about falling. It isn’t. It’s about trust. You don’t sit on a wall unless you trust the wall. You don’t climb high unless you trust what holds you up. And you don’t build relationships unless you trust the people around you._
**[Five candidates agreed Colorado has problems. Voters must decide who owns them](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s0p6494e746)** **BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD | STATE | JUNE 5** _Colorado has become so expensive that starter homes are starting to sound less like milestones and more like bucket-list items. Businesses are beginning to treat Colorado the way some retirees treat winter: nice place to visit, not entirely sure about staying. The surprising part isn’t that Republicans said so. It’s that Democrats did too._
**[Buying American is about more than the price tag](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Ow/s0i92a73da6)** **BY KAREN POST | COMMENTARY | JUNE 5** _This year, our country turns 250. Anniversaries are not just markers of time — they are moments of reflection. What kind of America do we want to be for the next 250 years? My answer is simple: one that invests in its own prosperity._

**Feel like you have a unique story, commentary or tip to share?** Email [submit@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:submit@rockymountainvoice.com).
|
---
|
---
🤔**DID YOU KNOW?** On March 17, 1905, Colorado had **three different governors hold office within 24 hours**. Democrat Alva Adams was forced out due to voting irregularities, replaced by Republican James Peabody on the condition that he immediately resign, who then handed the seat to Lieutenant Governor Jesse McDonald.
|

---

It's clear that this administration cannot be trusted with unfettered, warrantless surveillance of Americans.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133018396/626456069/2140832878?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOTkzMjMyYi00NjY0LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4BRrh-eTR2V5w5kg4dWo3NkB9i8o1Or729Bymro0144=&emci=e89b69cb-3f64-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&emdi=e993232b-4664-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=9818364)

| | For nearly 20 years, Congress has been granting presidential administrations the power to spy on American citizens without a warrant under Section 702 of a little-known law called the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA). There are a lot of parts of this law that are important for national security and to protect us against foreign threats. But the federal government has no business running a program to spy on its own citizens without a court order. Presidents from both sides of the aisle have abused these powers. This isn't a red issue or a blue issue. NO presidential administration should have this authority. Since this law went into effect, I've been leading the charge in Congress to implement real reforms to rein in presidential spying authorities under Section 702. Last week, we had a big victory in this battle. Right now, Trump's enablers in Congress are trying their best to renew this spying program. But early Friday morning, we successfully defeated a bill in the Senate to rubber-stamp these powers. It was defeated on the Senate floor 47 to 52. We have never seen a coalition like the one that stood up against this legislation. Elected officials on both sides of the aisle are waking up to the fact that NO president should have this power. I'm going to keep leading the charge in the Senate for real reforms that don't sacrifice Americans' constitutional right to privacy. We disagree. Georgia has the power to shape the future of our rights, our freedoms, and our democracy — and this year, we have an incredible opportunity to elect Democratic pro-choice women to two of the state's most powerful offices. EMILYs List is proud to support Keisha Lance Bottoms for governor andstate Rep. Tanya Miller for attorney general. = | = Keisha Lance Bottoms is the battle-tested leader Georgia needs to meet this moment. As Atlanta's former mayor, she led her city through crisis and built a strong record that can win tough statewide races. Now, she's running for governor to fight for Georgia families, defend our fundamental freedoms, and move this critical battleground state forward. State Rep. Tanya Miller is running for Georgia attorney general — and EMILYs List is proud to have her back. A former prosecutor and state representative, Tanya has spent her career taking on tough fights for victims, workers, and families. This year, she's running to be Georgia’s top legal officer at a time when attorneys general are on the front lines of protecting our rights and holding Republican extremists accountable. name: The Democratic National Committee
subject: Derek, you are not an ATM →
body:
---
Derek, If you’re on other email lists, you probably receive panicked emails from PACs and politicians trying to scare you into donating. That’s especially true right now, with the mid-month deadline just around the corner and November’s midterm elections rapidly approaching. Maybe you’re already seeing your inbox flooded with requests for donations. But here’s what we believe, Derek:
* **You are _not_ an ATM.** You are an invaluable part of our organization and our mission.
* We strive to give you valuable information about the DNC’s work that we hope will inspire you to join us — not scare you into making a rushed decision based on a false sense of urgency.
* Our goal is always to make sure you have accurate, up-to-date information about how we put your grassroots contribution to work.

So here’s the truth: The DNC is the only organization working around the clock, _every single year_ , to distribute funds and resources to all 50 state parties and the races that need it most. We have a team of experts on staff who spend their days strategizing to help Democrats fight back, organize, and win elections. We set our fundraising goals thoughtfully and intentionally to ensure that we have the resources we need to continue that work, all over the country. [**So, Derek, when you receive an email from the DNC asking for your support, that’s exactly where your contribution goes. Your contribution will help us organize across the country, register new Democrats in key swing states, and work towards winning back Congress this year. My name is Adam Schwarze._**I’m a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran who joined the military right after 9/11.**_ I fought in the Battle of Najaf in Iraq and deployed nine times to over 70 countries in defense of this nation. * Law and order with full support for our police
* Lower taxes and less government burden on families and small businesses

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240894%2E444211%2E5lZ_x-)
I want you to meet Juli Powell.
Powered by People is very much a community, a family even for some. We’re light on hierarchy and individual accolades, heavy on team-building and mutual support.
And yet within this community of thousands of everyday Texans doing their best to save our state and country, there are some who really go the extra mile (and then some).
Juli is one of them.
After she closed her successful dental practice in Austin a few years ago, she was looking for a way to be useful and to make the most of her extraordinary leadership and organizing skills. Lucky for us (and for Texas), she found Powered by People and got to work.
She quickly became a stand out in our Travis County program, posting up with other volunteers on the University of Texas and Austin Community College campuses, and finding other venues and opportunities to meet young and future voters wherever they might be.
There she would talk with them, listen to their concerns and interests, get them registered to vote and stay in touch with them throughout the election cycle, answering questions, providing useful resources and nudging them to vote until she could confirm that their ballots were cast.
She also took on the task of training new volunteers to our program, spending hundreds of hours patiently walking through the details of our process, responding to questions, overseeing newly deployed volunteers and developing a training regimen that we are still using today.
And then this.
We learned late last week the Texas Democratic Party was having a hard time reaching all the county registrars (there are 254 of them!) to get their individual updated voter files that allow groups like ours to have the latest data to inform our engagement with new voters.
This information is critical for the work we do, and without it our volunteers are at a big disadvantage. For example, without updated data they may waste time trying to register someone who is already on the rolls.
To fill the gap, Powered by People offered to reach out to these hundreds of county voter offices to request the files, ensure they are delivered to the party and that the voter file is current and usable by our volunteers, by candidates and by anyone else working to win political power for Democrats.
And it is Juli Powell who has spent every day this week making the calls, requesting the data, and doing the work to ensure that our volunteers have what they need in the field.
**She is a standout, an inspiration and an amazing example of the thousands of PXP volunteers giving everything they’ve got to make sure that we meet the moment and win in November.**
[**Please contribute today so that we have the resources to keep our volunteers going and to recruit and train more of them for the work ahead.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260609.TNVWrs&refcode=ema20260609-240894&t=3&akid=240894%2E444211%2E5lZ_x-)
**[Donate $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260609.TNVWrs&refcode=ema20260609-240894&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=240894%2E444211%2E5lZ_x-)**
Thank you,
Beto

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end.

Sincerely,
Susan Collins

Hi there,
This year America commemorates 250 years of independence.
Families are gathering. Communities are celebrating. The cultural conversation is turning toward the American founding. And for the first time in years, there's a genuine hunger for storytelling that honors this legacy and explores what America has meant to the world.
This moment only comes once.
According to a 2024 Gallup survey, 71% of Americans say they plan to participate in 250th anniversary celebrations. They're actively seeking content for their children—films, books, and stories that help them understand why this moment matters and what their ancestors believed in.

clean_body: Seize This Moment for America's Future America's 250th is here—Son of 1776 will reach millions of young people, but only with your support right now. Hi there, This year America commemorates 250 years of independence. Families are gathering. Communities are celebrating. The cultural conversation is turning toward the American founding. And for the first time in years, there's a genuine hunger for storytelling that honors this legacy and explores what America has meant to the world. This moment only comes once. According to a 2024 Gallup survey, 71% of Americans say they plan to participate in 250th anniversary celebrations. They're actively seeking content for their children—films, books, and stories that help them understand why this moment matters and what their ancestors believed in. Son of 1776 is the animated feature that will reach millions of young Americans exactly when they're seeking to connect with their nation's story. But production won't complete itself. Every dollar donated today directly funds the animation, music, storytelling, and promotion that will help Gen Alpha understand the sacrifices that built this great nation. No other organization is stepping up to create this kind of content right now. That's why the Moving Picture Institute exists. | | ---|---|--- | | Sincerely, Joseph Corey Vice President of Philanthropic Investments The Moving Picture Institute | 375 Greenwich Street New York NY 10013

Our congressman doesn't do that. Our campaign has held more real town halls in eight months than Dan Meuser has in _seven years_. Because he's held zero.

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Public school enrollment is declining in Texas
body:
Texas is still near the bottom nationally in per-student funding.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Texas public schools are in trouble, Peter. Big time. And Greg Abbott is making it worse.
This year, Texas public schools saw **76,000 fewer students enrolled for the first time in nearly _four decades_** — a large portion of these kids being Hispanic.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260609_2_schools.qIKpLX&refcode=em20260609-1299&amount=5&t=1&akid=1299%2E299639%2EdLdh80)
Abbott loves to boast about investing in education, but even after last year’s one-time $8.5 billion funding package, **Texas is still near the bottom nationally in per-student funding.**
And now, with this voucher scheme that drains public dollars out of neighborhood schools towards students who are already in private school, it’s very clear who this scheme is meant to serve. _And it’s definitely _not_ working families._
**Abbott is subsidizing the wealthy, and we have a chance to change that this November.**
I’m running for governor because Texas kids deserve a leader who will fight to fund public schools, pay educators what they’re worth, and stop selling out our communities to billionaires.
**[If you’re with me, will you chip in $5 or any amount today to help us beat Abbott in November and protect Texas public schools?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260609_2_schools.qIKpLX&refcode=em20260609-1299&amount=5&t=2&akid=1299%2E299639%2EdLdh80)**

Peter, Our pro-democracy movement is navigating incredibly choppy waters right now. We’re in the middle of a national redistricting crisis, and we must stay nimble to respond to new threats. But we’ve still got our eyes on the North Star: Building a truly representative democracy. Take it from our chair, Attorney General Eric H. Holder Jr., who recently charted the course ahead in a guest essay for _The New York Times:_ | "Make no mistake: Republicans, with the aid of the court, are attacking the right to vote for all Americans, whose representatives in Congress will increasingly reflect the preferences of district line-drawers and their most partisan supporters." **"The next time Democrats take control of Congress and the White House, their top priority must be to rebuild and reimagine American democracy,** creating a system that, more than ever before, reflects and is responsive to the will of the American people." “That means banning partisan gerrymandering — and much more.” — Attorney General Eric Holder

* Banning partisan gerrymandering and mid-decade redistricting
* Protecting fair representation for voters of color
* Combating voter suppression
* Reforming the Supreme Court, including 18-year term limits and a binding code of ethics

That’s the long game.
And for now, at the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, we’re racing to stop MAGA Republicans from locking themselves in power.

clean_body: Take it from the former Attorney General: | Peter, Our pro-democracy movement is navigating incredibly choppy waters right now. We’re in the middle of a national redistricting crisis, and we must stay nimble to respond to new threats. But we’ve still got our eyes on the North Star: Building a truly representative democracy. Take it from our chair, Attorney General Eric H. Holder Jr., who recently charted the course ahead in a guest essay for The New York Times: | "Make no mistake: Republicans, with the aid of the court, are attacking the right to vote for all Americans, whose representatives in Congress will increasingly reflect the preferences of district line-drawers and their most partisan supporters." "The next time Democrats take control of Congress and the White House, their top priority must be to rebuild and reimagine American democracy, creating a system that, more than ever before, reflects and is responsive to the will of the American people." “That means banning partisan gerrymandering — and much more.” — Attorney General Eric Holder = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = A.G. Holder has laid out pro-democracy reforms that Democrats must prioritize: Banning partisan gerrymandering and mid-decade redistricting Protecting fair representation for voters of color Combating voter suppression Reforming the Supreme Court, including 18-year term limits and a binding code of ethics That’s the long game. And for now, at the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, we’re racing to stop MAGA Republicans from locking themselves in power. State by state, we must prevent new GOP gerrymanders, including insidious attempts to erase representation for Black and brown Americans. First, we save our democracy. body:
A Fox News poll shows me ahead in Ohio’s Senate race.
Team —
The first public poll of the general election in Ohio was just released, and you need to take a look:
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260609_2.Q5M17j&refcode=em20260609-2&t=1&akid=7105%2E582294%2Ed8V3Rz)
This is a big deal. It’s the first public poll of the general election — and the data proves Ohio is ready to unseat my opponent, Jon Husted, and pave a path for us to flip the Senate in November.
**The momentum behind our campaign is growing, but so is the target on our backs. Republicans can see we’re putting up a fight, and they’re going to do whatever it takes to stop us in our tracks.[Before I say more, can you split any amount between my campaign and Chris Pappas so we can hit our $100K rapid response goal and take on whatever’s next?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260609_2.Q5M17j&refcode=em20260609-2&t=2&akid=7105%2E582294%2Ed8V3Rz)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260609_2.Q5M17j&amount=5&refcode=em20260609-2&t=3&akid=7105%2E582294%2Ed8V3Rz)**
What we’re building together is truly remarkable, and I see it at every stop I make across the state. Folks are fed up with rising costs, rampant corruption, and a rigged system that makes it impossible to get ahead no matter how hard you work. So they’re showing up to make a change and proving that we have the support to flip this seat, even in a state Trump won by 11 points last time.
Seriously, we’re 8 points ahead of our opponent in this latest poll. _That’s the good news._
Here’s the tough part: Outside Republican groups and corporations see these polls, too. **They’ve already publicly announced I’m one of their top targets and are spending $83 million against me, so another poll like this will give them all the more reason to dump a fortune into Ohio to take me down.**
I don’t know what’s coming next, but I know the _only_ way we can keep this going in our favor is by fighting hard each and every day until the election. Ohio broke the record for the most expensive Senate race in history last time, so we need a lot of support if we’re going to pull this off.
**Your $5 might not seem like a lot on its own, but it all adds up when thousands of folks chip in whatever they can, whenever they can — even if it’s just $5 at a time.[If you’re with me, I’m earnestly asking if you can split a donation between my campaign and Chris Pappas before midnight. Everything counts and means a ton to me personally.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260609_2.Q5M17j&refcode=em20260609-2&t=4&akid=7105%2E582294%2Ed8V3Rz)**

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

* The cost of groceries
* Filling up their gas tanks
* Paying their bills and making ends meet
What I don't hear is people asking Congress to spend billions more taxpayer dollars on another prolonged war overseas.
Yet that's exactly what's happening.
Every day this conflict drags on, it risks costing American taxpayers billions of dollars while driving up the costs that working families already struggle to afford.
That's backward.
Our government should be focused on lowering costs, strengthening our communities, and solving problems here at home—not writing blank checks for an open-ended war with no clear strategy or end.
That's why I voted to end this war. And that's why I'm asking you to join me today.
